title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Required Qualifications


  • 3 to 5 years of software engineering experience with hands-on application development responsibilities.
  • 1 to 3 years of practical experience developing Generative AI applications, AI assistants, AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience building APIs, integrations, and enterprise applications.
  • Working knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and common AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more AI development frameworks, such as LangGraph, LangChain, Claude Code SDK, OpenAI SDK, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI gateways, agent-to-agent communication, or tool-calling frameworks.
  • Experience implementing AI agents, orchestration workflows, tool integrations, or agentic applications.
  • Experience building proofs of concept, prototypes, or reference implementations.
  • Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, data platforms, and APIs.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and evaluation approaches for AI solution quality, safety, reliability, and performance.
  • Awareness of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, security controls, and enterprise data protection requirements.
  • Experience with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, containers, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Familiarity with Azure or AWS services used to host and operate applications and AI workloads.
  • Ability to work with business stakeholders and application development teams to translate requirements into working software.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT models, SpaceX Grok Models, Gemini, or similar enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience building RAG solutions, knowledge assistants, or AI-powered search capabilities.
  • Exposure to multi-agent systems and agent orchestration workflows.
  • Experience integrating applications with ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized application deployment, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience working in financial services or another regulated industry.

Supported by a vast community of medical experts and focused on clinic success and patient safety, MEDFAR was the first company to certify a cloud-based Electronic Medical Record (EMR) in Canada: MYLE (Make Your Life Easy).

Committed to driving excellence and efficiency in healthcare worldwide, MEDFAR sets itself apart by offering a unique care management solution for clinics that replaces inefficient processes with a faster, safer technological alternative.



Job Description

As a Mid-level Data Migration Developer, you will be involved in the use and development of data transfer devices and interfaces. Reporting to the Director of Deployment and Continuous Improvement, you will join a multidisciplinary team whose mandate is to welcome new clients and guide them in the adoption of our care management solutions.

title: Generative AI Consultant
description:
Note: La langue de travail pour ce poste est l'anglais. Une description du poste en français est disponible à la fin de cette offre.

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Sia’s AI & Data Business Unit is the powerhouse of our firm’s innovation—merging cutting-edge Data Science, Generative AI, and advanced digital solutions to transform industries. With over 350 experts worldwide, we tackle projects from proof-of-concept to large-scale deployment, always pushing the boundaries of AI capabilities. Our 12 R&D labs in Europe and North America drive continuous research in areas like computer vision, MLOps, and deep learning, partnering closely with our business consultants for real-world impact. By joining Sia’s AI & Data team, you’ll step into a vibrant, collaborative environment that nurtures professional growth and empowers you to shape the future of AI-driven consulting.



Job Description

Join us as an experienced Generative AI Specialist designing and implementing cutting-edge GenAI/LLM solutions across diverse industries. You'll act as a vital bridge between technical teams (Data Science, ML, Platform) to deliver business-centric AI value. You'll guide clients on the optimal path—using techniques like RAG, agents, or fine-tuning—for cost-effective impact.

Your responsibilities extend beyond prompting to architecting robust AI products via benchmarking, prototyping, and validation. You'll orchestrate the full AI workflow, ensuring seamless model integration optimized for performance, security, and scale, while tackling infrastructure challenges. We provide extensive training to support your success. If you're driven to push AI boundaries and help clients rapidly adopt GenAI with confidence, apply to make a real difference.

Responsibilities:

  • LLM/GenAI System Development: Design, build, train, fine-tune, and deploy sophisticated AI models leveraging LLMs (e.g., GPT-x, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) and other generative techniques.
  • Assist in Solution Architecture: Support the GenAI Solution Architect in designing robust, scalable, and secure applications.
  • Application Development: Develop applications powered by GenAI models (both self-managed and API-accessible) that meet business needs and comply with applicable regulations (GDPR, EU AI Act, model licenses, etc.).
  • Advanced Prompt Engineering: Design and optimize effective prompts (e.g., few-shot, Chain/Tree/Graph of Thought, ReAct, Self-reflection, guardrails), balancing simplicity and complexity to enhance analytical capabilities, refine outputs, improve user experience, and control interactions.
  • RAG Implementation: Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to improve accuracy and relevance by retrieving information from pre-determined knowledge sources, providing traceability (source attribution).
  • Model Selection & Fine-Tuning: Select and fine-tune appropriate models (including multimodal - VLM, SLM - Visual Language Models, Small Language Models) to create higher-quality content (text, image, audio, code, etc.) and maximize business value creation opportunities.
  • Integration & Deployment (MLOps): Implement MLOps best practices for the GenAI lifecycle, including automated pipelines (CI/CD), versioning, monitoring, and maintenance in production environments (Cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP). Ensure seamless integration into existing systems and with external tools/APIs, potentially utilizing standardized protocols (MCP).
  • Evaluation & Responsible AI: Develop and execute rigorous evaluation frameworks to measure model performance, reliability, fairness, and safety. Ensure adherence to Responsible AI principles and help teams and clients navigate end-to-end security and compliance processes.
  • Research & Innovation: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in GenAI techniques, technologies, and frameworks. Experiment with new approaches and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.
  • Collaboration: Work effectively within cross-functional teams, communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders (both technical and non-technical).
  • Documentation: Document processes, methodologies, and best practices for knowledge sharing and future reference.
  • Use Case Differentiation: Distinguish between use cases suited for Generative AI versus traditional NLP applications (e.g., NER, sentiment analysis).

Qualifications

Education:

  • Master's degree or Engineering degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience: 1-3+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, software engineering, or data science, with demonstrated experience on complex AI projects specifically involving LLMs and Generative AI.

Required Technical Skills:

  • Strong programming skills, particularly in Python.
  • Proficiency in at least one major GenAI application framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
  • Proven experience in NLP/NLU, vector embeddings, and semantic search.
  • Hands-on experience with fine-tuning LLMs.
  • Mastery of advanced prompting techniques (Chain/Tree/Graph of Thought, ReAct, etc.).
  • Knowledge of both proprietary and open-source model ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral AI, Hugging Face, models hosted on AWS/Azure/GCP, etc.).
  • Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their associated MLOps/AI services.
  • Familiarity with MLOps principles, CI/CD tools, Docker, and Git.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), ability to explain complex technical concepts simply.
  • Strong analytical and complex problem-solving abilities.
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse profiles.
  • Curiosity, pioneering spirit, and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building agentic AI systems (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen).
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma, OpenSearch).
  • Experience developing conversational AI systems / chatbots.
  • Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Understanding of or experience with protocols and standards for connecting LLMs to external tools and databases, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience deploying models at scale in production environments.

Additional Information

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.



*************************************

Description résumée du poste en français:



Nous recherchons un conseiller en IA générative pour rejoindre son équipe AI & Data, au cœur des projets d’innovation du cabinet. Le rôle consiste à concevoir, déployer et mettre en production des solutions GenAI à fort impact pour des clients issus de secteurs variés.

Le ou la spécialiste interviendra sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions IA :

choix des modèles, prompt engineering avancé, architectures RAG, fine-tuning, intégration et MLOps, tout en assurant performance, sécurité, conformité et IA responsable.

Le poste implique une forte collaboration avec les équipes Data, ML, plateformes et business, ainsi qu’un rôle-conseil auprès des clients pour identifier les meilleurs cas d’usage et accélérer l’adoption de l’IA générative.

Profil recherché : expérience concrète en IA générative et LLM, maîtrise de Python, NLP, embeddings, frameworks GenAI (LangChain, LlamaIndex), cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) et bonnes pratiques MLOps.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: UX/UI Designer 2
location: This hybrid position is based out of Eden Prairie, MN office.
description:
As a UX/UI Designer 2 at Capstone, you'll use your creativity, technical skills, and passion for user-centered design to create engaging and intuitive digital experiences for educators and students. You'll play an important role in enhancing our growing PebbleGo Suite and helping shape new digital products, websites, mobile applications, and internal tools.


Working closely with Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams, you'll help identify and solve usability challenges, translate user needs into effective design solutions, and ensure our digital products are accessible, engaging, and easy to use.


In this role, you'll contribute to all stages of the design process, from research and discovery through prototyping, testing, and delivery. You'll have the opportunity to bring innovative ideas to life and help create meaningful learning experiences for students and teachers across the country.


This hybrid position is based out of Eden Prairie, MN office. Employees are expected to work from their designated office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the flexibility to work remotely up to three (3) days per week.


Why You Will Want to Join Capstone

We support teaching and learning with amazing content that engages students, inspires teachers, and connects families and communities to move literacy forward. Capstone is a fast-paced growth company committed to cultivating a love of reading and learning. We know that Learning is for Everyone.


For over 30 years, Capstone has been a national leader in K-5 educational content including digital products (PebbleGo, PebbleGo Next, PebbleGo Create, Capstone Interactive, Capstone Connect) and award-winning books. We combine a passion for helping foster a powerful love of reading and learning with the talent to create amazing content.


We are a mission-driven company that provides opportunities for professional learning and development and a culture of inclusion and belonging.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Design & User Experience

  • Support and lead UX/UI design activities throughout the product development lifecycle, from discovery and research through design and delivery.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, visual designs, and other design deliverables that improve the user experience.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform design decisions.
  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of Capstone's Design System to ensure consistent and accessible user experiences.
  • Contribute to production, animation, and front-end design activities as needed.

Problem-Solving & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams to develop user-centered solutions that balance usability, feasibility, and business needs.
  • Identify and troubleshoot UX/UI challenges, including accessibility and WCAG compliance.
  • Manage design handoffs and provide ongoing support to software development teams within an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Communicate design recommendations, research findings, and opportunities for product innovation.
  • Explore emerging technologies, including AI, to improve design workflows and enhance digital experiences.

Education, Experience, and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in User Experience Design, Web Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of professional UX/UI design experience.
  • Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, FigJam, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Experience with user-centered design, including user research, usability testing, wireframing, prototyping, and information architecture.
  • Strong understanding of mobile-first and responsive design principles, usability, and accessibility best practices.
  • Familiarity with Agile development processes and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Knowledge of design frameworks such as Lean UX, Design Thinking, and Design Sprints.
  • Ability to identify user needs, solve design challenges, and translate research into effective design solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to present ideas and incorporate feedback.
  • Self-directed, creative, and adaptable, with a passion for design, innovation, and continuous learning.

Additional Qualifications Preferred

  • Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  • Experience in K–12 educational technology or designing products for students and educators.
  • Background in instructional design or educational games.
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies such as AI, voice user interfaces (VUI), and AR/VR.

Travel Requirements

5-10% travel may be required.


Inclusion & Belonging

Capstone embraces equal opportunity and belonging for all employees and applicants. We are an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All candidate information will be kept private according to EEO guidelines. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request to hrservices@capstonepub.com.


The pay range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are surrounding compensation including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, work location, and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $75,000-$90,000.


Capstone strives to provide comprehensive and market-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Click here to see our benefits.

title: NLP Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an NLP Engineer based in Canada.

As an NLP Engineer, you will develop, train, and optimize advanced language models powering intelligent conversational experiences and AI-driven products. You will work across the entire machine learning lifecycle, from dataset preparation and model fine-tuning to evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. Your focus will be on adapting language models to evolving conversational scenarios, improving response quality, and ensuring reliable and efficient model performance. You will experiment with different models, prompting strategies, and inference technologies to balance accuracy, latency, and operational costs. Working closely with engineering and product teams, you will transform NLP research and experimentation into scalable, production-ready solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to globally distributed digital products within an international, remote-first technology environment.

Accountabilities

  • Language Model Development: Train, fine-tune, and improve language models used in AI-powered conversational assistants and copilots. Adapt models to new conversation scenarios, response requirements, and structured output formats.
  • Dataset Preparation and Management: Build, prepare, and maintain high-quality training and evaluation datasets. Identify data gaps, analyze model errors, define annotation requirements, and review annotated examples to improve model performance.
  • Model Selection and Prompt Engineering: Evaluate and compare internally hosted language models with external model APIs, assessing response quality, latency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Develop and optimize prompts to achieve consistent and relevant outputs.
  • Model Evaluation and Benchmarking: Maintain evaluation datasets and performance benchmarks, using automated assessments, human reviews, and other evaluation techniques to measure generated text quality. Identify regressions, investigate unsatisfactory responses, and incorporate user feedback into improvements.
  • Model Deployment and API Development: Build, package, and maintain services and APIs around language models using FastAPI or comparable frameworks. Support reliable deployment and integration of models into production applications.
  • Inference Optimization: Improve model inference speed, GPU memory utilization, and serving costs while maintaining the required response quality and performance standards.
  • Production Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Implement logging, monitoring, and appropriate testing processes to maintain production reliability. Investigate technical issues, manage deployment failures, and support rollback procedures when necessary.
  • Recommendation Systems: Contribute to recommendation-related capabilities and explore opportunities to apply NLP and machine learning techniques to improve product experiences.
  • Technical Documentation: Maintain reproducible experiments, document technical decisions and results, and ensure solutions are understandable and maintainable by other engineering team members.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into effective NLP solutions and deliver improvements to AI-powered features.

Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code beyond research notebooks.
  • Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including a solid understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, model training, and text generation.
  • Hands-on experience adapting and fine-tuning language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA.
  • Strong understanding of dataset preparation, validation, quality control, and data leakage prevention.
  • Ability to investigate model errors, identify weaknesses in training data, and develop strategies to improve model performance.
  • Experience evaluating generated text using benchmarks, automated evaluation methods, and human review.
  • Understanding of the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different language models and evaluation approaches.
  • Practical experience working with model APIs, prompt engineering, and structured output generation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and Git, including experience deploying machine learning models on GPU infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of model inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, automated tests, and production troubleshooting procedures.
  • Ability to investigate production failures, identify root causes, and manage safe release or rollback processes.
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to retrieve, query, and analyze product data.
  • English proficiency sufficient to understand technical documentation, research papers, and communicate technical concepts.
  • Practical experience with recommendation systems, even at an introductory or project level.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to experimentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed engineering team.

Benefits

  • Fully Remote Work: Full-time remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from different locations.
  • Competitive Compensation: The initial salary level or compensation range will be communicated during the recruitment process, before employment begins.
  • Generous Annual Leave: 28 calendar days of paid vacation per year.
  • Wellness Days: 7 additional wellness days annually to manage personal matters, rest, or recover without using sick leave.
  • Children's Education Support: Reimbursement of 50% of kindergarten or school expenses, up to $1,000 gross per year per child, subject to eligibility after the integration period.
  • Referral Bonuses: Bonuses of up to $5,000 for recommending successful candidates for open positions.
  • Professional Development: 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
  • Language Learning: Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
  • Healthcare Support: Health insurance benefits or reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee for eligible healthcare expenses, including personally purchased insurance and medical consultations for employees and close family members.
  • Remote Workplace Support: Workplace equipment and infrastructure provided in company offices or coworking locations. Employees working elsewhere may receive reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years for home-office equipment, internet, or coworking expenses.
  • Employee Recognition Program: Access to an internal gamified appreciation system where colleagues can award bonuses that can be exchanged for company merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
  • International Work Environment: Opportunity to collaborate with a globally distributed team of technology professionals and contribute to products used across different markets.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Onsite 3 days/week


About the role

  • A leading financial services institution is growing its AI practice and is looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run production AI solutions on Azure and Databricks. description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The Director, Product Management, AI & Product Office owns AI-enabled products that help the Chief AI & Product Officer (CAIPO) drive Optum Health's enterprise AI-enabled product strategy, Agenix solutions portfolio, and product capability agenda. Serving as strategist, builder, and owner of the outcome, this role defines the problem with the people who do the work, decides what gets built and why, and takes each product from first prototype through deployment and measurement.


This individual is accountable for measurable enterprise value: whether what shipped changed care for patients and care teams, whether it did so appropriately, and whether it earns the return required to scale. The Sr Product Manager keeps the work focused on the smallest version that can prove or disprove a bet, and brings clinical, operational, technology, and governance partners into one team rather than a chain of handoffs.


This is a job for a builder. The team is just starting, and you will help build it and shape how it innovates, at the highest level. The office is small today, and that is by design: its leverage is the enterprise AI investment it drives across Optum Health. You will write, prototype, and analyze with AI tools every day, and you will be where care is delivered, not only in meetings about it.


The AI & Product Office is building a small, cross-functional product team: product management, engineering, product design, service design, deployment, and clinical, working alongside care team members from each local market team. The team embeds with a local Optum Health market team to find problems with the people who do the work, then design, build, deploy, and measure the products that fix them. What the team learns in the first market is written down as the method for the next one.


You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.


For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Problem Definition & Discovery
    • Embed with local market teams in primary care, specialty, home and community, and virtual settings to understand how care is delivered, and turn what you observe into written problem statements ranked by the people who do the work
    • Define, before build begins, the smallest version of a product that can prove or disprove the bet, the outcome measure that will decide it, and the business case it must meet to scale
    • Partner with care team members as design partners from the first conversation, not as reviewers at the end
    • Determine which problems belong to a single market and which belong to the enterprise, and shape each product accordingly
  • Build & Delivery
    • Own the roadmap and backlog for your products, making tradeoffs across scope, speed, risk, and cost, and write each decision down with its reasoning and what would change it
    • Run the work as one team rather than a chain of handoffs, with cycle time measured in weeks
    • Work with the team's engineers and with great Optum Health engineering teams: set direction, write the specifications and evaluations the build is held to, and review what ships
    • Build prototypes, analyses, and internal tools yourself with AI coding and agent tools, and continuously improve them
    • Partner with finance, technology, data, security, legal, privacy, compliance, care teams, and other stakeholders to deliver products that are responsible, secure, and enterprise-ready, including through Optum Health's AI review and governance process
  • Measurement & Value Realization
    • Define, with clinical and governance partners, what an AI feature must get right, how it is measured, the bar it must clear before it reaches users, and the bar it must clear before it takes on more autonomy
    • Establish baselines before launch for operational, clinical, and financial outcomes, such as access, time to care, and cost, so the change can be attributed
    • Measure whether each patient got the right care, not only whether a proxy metric moved
    • Report what changed since the last period, including results that show something did not work, and turn results into decisions to stop, change, or scale
    • Build the value case for scaling each product, and partner with finance to validate it
  • Adoption & Scale
    • Develop change management and adoption plans with the deployment manager, so the people affected understand the purpose, impact, readiness requirements, and expected value of each product
    • Write down what the team learns each week so it is reviewed on cadence and turned into decisions
    • Hand proven products to scaled delivery teams, and write the playbook so the next team can stand up the same product from what is written down, without you
    • Raise the AI fluency of the market teams you work with, helping the people closest to the work use and build with AI safely


You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

  • Experience leading products from discovery through implementation, including roadmap development, requirements definition, measurement of outcomes, and cross-functional delivery

  • Experience shipping products with engineering teams both inside and beyond their own team

  • Works as a senior individual contributor: owns hard problems end to end, working across functions to deliver them

  • Proven ability to build cross-functional relationships at all levels of the organization and lead toward shared goals without formal authority

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Location: Guelph, Ontario, Full Time in Office.

Reports To: Head of Technology and Information Security

Job Type: New Vacancy, Full Time, Permanent

Salary: $110,000 - $130,000


Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to help design and establish the technical foundations for the next generation of our business applications and digital platforms.

This role combines broad architectural responsibility with hands-on software engineering across application development, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, data, integration, security, and production operations. It is not an advisory- or documentation-only position. The successful candidate is an experienced software engineer who has grown into architecture and remained technically hands-on.

The Solution Architect will translate business needs into practical technical designs by establishing application and platform architecture, creating reference implementations, application skeletons, and foundational components, and working directly with developers to turn those designs into production systems.

The successful candidate will balance long-term architectural direction with pragmatic, incremental modernization by determining what to retain, refactor, separate, modernize, or replace, and by establishing repeatable architectural and AI-assisted engineering practices across the organization.


Key Responsibilities


Solution Architecture & Technical Design

  • Translate business functionality, product requirements, operational needs, and technical constraints into technical platform capabilities and practical solution designs.
  • Evaluate existing systems and recommend when components should be retained, refactored, modularized, migrated, replaced, retired, built, or bought.
  • Incorporate security, privacy, quality, operational resilience, scalability, performance, maintainability, testability, and cost into architectural decisions.
  • Create production-quality application skeletons, reference implementations, reusable components, services, and proofs of concept that establish technical direction and demonstrate design patterns, dependency boundaries, error handling, logging, configuration, and other engineering conventions.


Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps Architecture

  • Collaborate with the Azure Administrator to design cloud-based solutions considering application hosting, networking, identity, storage, databases, monitoring, resilience, backup and recovery.
  • Work with the DevOps Architect to establish reliable CI/CD practices to support build-once/promote practices, versioned artifacts, automated quality controls, database-change management, feature flags, rollback strategies, and deployment validation.


Integration, API & Data Architecture

  • Design REST APIs, service contracts, events, webhooks, and other integration mechanisms using clear ownership and versioning boundaries.
  • Define appropriate approaches for synchronous and asynchronous processing based on solution requirements.
  • Design data flows, schemas, transformations, and ownership boundaries.
  • Help establish API lifecycle and governance practices covering authentication, authorization, versioning, throttling, monitoring, documentation, deprecation, and change management.


Security & Identity by Design

  • Design authentication, authorization, and role-based access approaches using modern identity technologies and least-privilege principles.
  • Incorporate sensitive data handling, secure coding, encryption, secrets management, logging, auditability, vulnerability management, and security monitoring requirements into solution designs.


Architecture Governance & Modernization

  • Develop and maintain current-state and target-state architecture documentation for business-critical applications and services, including architecture diagrams, data flows, and deployment designs that communicate how solutions work.
  • Create and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for significant technical decisions and their rationale.
  • Establish engineering and technology standards covering supported frameworks, libraries, platforms, and lifecycle expectations.
  • Identify technical debt and help prioritize remediation based on business impact, security risk, operational risk, supportability, change frequency, and strategic value.
  • Participate in evaluating third-party products, development partners, platforms, and vendor-proposed technical designs.


Qualifications & Skills


Required Experience

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant responsibility for designing complex production systems
  • 3+ years performing solution, application, software, or related technical architecture responsibilities, whether formally titled as an architect or performed as a senior/principal engineer, where you established architecture governance, ADRs, engineering standards, or technology lifecycle practices.

title: Director of Product Strategy
description:
Capstone is looking for a strategic and innovative Director of Product Strategy to lead the vision and direction of our PebbleGo product portfolio. In this key leadership role, you'll help shape what's next for our digital learning solutions by identifying market opportunities, understanding the needs of educators and students, and developing strategies that drive meaningful customer value and long-term business growth.


You'll lead our Product Strategy function, overseeing product development, content and instructional strategy, and customer experience while collaborating across teams to bring new ideas and opportunities to life. From product innovation and competitive positioning to pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy, you'll play an important role in driving the continued growth and success of PebbleGo.


If you're a forward-thinking product leader who is passionate about education, innovation, and building products that make a difference, we'd love to connect with you


This hybrid position is based out of Eden Prairie, MN office. Employees are expected to work from their designated office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the flexibility to work remotely up to three (3) days per week.


Why You’ll Want to Join Capstone

At Capstone, we support teaching and learning through engaging content that inspires students, empowers teachers, and connects families and communities to advance literacy. We are a fast-paced, mission-driven company committed to cultivating a love of reading and lifelong learning because we believe Learning is for Everyone.


For more than 30 years, Capstone has been a national leader in K–5 educational content, including digital products such as PebbleGo, PebbleGo Next, PebbleGo Create, Capstone Interactive, and Capstone Connect, along with award-winning children’s books. We combine a passion for literacy and learning with the creativity and innovation needed to build meaningful educational experiences.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Vision and Strategy

  • Develop and communicate a clear product vision and long-term strategy aligned with company and business objectives.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, competitive insights, and business priorities into actionable product strategies.
  • Set strategic priorities for future product and market opportunities and determine which opportunities advance through exploration and validation.
  • Own the 1–3 year integrated product and content roadmap, translating business strategy into clear portfolio priorities and investment choices.
  • Evaluate the overall product portfolio and recommend where to invest, expand, reposition, or simplify offerings.
  • Establish clear goals and measures of success for product initiatives.

Product Strategy Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Senior Manager of Product Development, Senior Product Strategist, and Customer Experience Manager, including coaching people leaders to build strong teams, develop talent, manage performance, and create clear accountability within their functions.
  • Establish strong product management practices, including product discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, business cases, and product lifecycle management.
  • Establish clear priorities, decision rights, and accountability across the function, empowering leaders to make decisions within their areas of responsibility.
  • Partner closely with Technology, Design, Content, and other teams to move product strategy from concept through development and launch.
  • Ensure product decisions are informed by customer feedback, market research, usage data, and business results.

Go-to-Market Partnership

  • Own Product Strategy's contribution to go-to-market planning, partnering with Sales and Marketing on positioning, launches, pricing, packaging, and market readiness.
  • Ensure product positioning and value propositions clearly communicate customer benefits and competitive differentiation.
  • Provide product and market expertise to support sales enablement, customer communications, launches, and adoption.
  • Evaluate product performance following launches and recommend adjustments based on customer and market response.

SaaS Pricing and Packaging

  • Own the development and ongoing evaluation of SaaS pricing and packaging strategy, including analysis and recommendations for major change
  • Use customer insights, competitive research, market data, and financial analysis to inform pricing decisions.
  • Evaluate opportunities to evolve subscription models, product bundles, packaging, and customer segmentation.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, and other stakeholders to understand the revenue and customer impact of pricing decisions.
  • Ensure pricing and packaging strategies support customer value, market competitiveness, adoption, retention, and sustainable revenue growth.

Market and Customer Insights

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the K–12 education and EdTech landscape, including customer needs, purchasing behaviors, competitive products, and emerging trends.
  • Build strong connections with educators, administrators, customers, and internal customer-facing teams to understand evolving needs.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform product priorities and investment decisions.
  • Monitor competitive offerings and identify opportunities for differentiation.
  • Bring an external and forward-looking perspective to product and business planning.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic product partner across the organization, connecting product strategy with broader business goals.
  • Build strong partnerships with Technology, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Content, Finance, and other teams.
  • Create alignment around product priorities, investment decisions, launches, and longer-term strategic opportunities.
  • Clearly communicate product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance to senior leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Help teams make thoughtful decisions when balancing customer needs, business goals, resources, and technical considerations.

Education, Experience, and Skills desired:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Product Management, Marketing, Technology, Education, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, or related roles, including meaningful experience leading and developing people and teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to create, own, and clearly communicate product vision and strategy, translating strategy into focused priorities and high-impact work.
  • Experience leading and developing managers and product teams, with the ability to create accountability, focus, and alignment across functions.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, product lifecycle management, and subscription-based digital products
  • Experience owning or shaping pricing, packaging, monetization, and portfolio decisions, ideally in B2B or institutional SaaS.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to use customer insight, market research, competitive intelligence, product performance, and data to guide decisions.
  • Agile, learning-oriented mindset with a focus on experimentation, iteration, and adapting direction based on evidence.
  • Strong communication and influence skills, including experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, Technology, and other cross-functional teams and communicating strategy to senior leaders.
  • Experience in K–12 education, EdTech, educational publishing, or another education-focused SaaS business, with an understanding of school and district buying dynamics preferred technologies.

Travel Requirements

10-15% travel may be required.

title: Wireless Network Engineer
description:
Wireless Network Engineer

Robotics & Automation | R&D | Wasquehal, France | On-site


About the Opportunity

  • I'm currently recruiting for a Wireless Network Engineer to join the R&D team of an innovative French robotics and automation company, recognised as one of Europe's leading technology businesses in the development of advanced robotic solutions.
  • The company designs and develops autonomous robotic systems used by some of the world's largest retail and industrial organisations, helping transform warehouse operations through advanced robotics, AI and automation technology.
  • As the Wireless Network Engineer, you'll take ownership of the wireless connectivity layer that powers these robotic systems, ensuring hundreds of autonomous robots can communicate reliably with backend services in complex, high-density environments.
  • This is a technically varied position sitting at the intersection of wireless networking, robotics, embedded software and systems engineering, with a direct impact on product performance and reliability.


The Role

  • You'll be responsible for designing, monitoring, analysing and continuously improving the wireless connectivity solutions used across the company's robotic fleet.
  • Working closely with Software and Systems Engineering teams, you'll investigate complex connectivity issues, optimise network performance and develop tools and methodologies to improve the reliability of communications across large-scale deployments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, monitor and optimise Wi-Fi connectivity for autonomous robotic systems.
  • Analyse and troubleshoot complex networking issues, including roaming, latency, packet loss, RF interference and TCP/IP performance.
  • Investigate wireless connectivity challenges in high-density environments with hundreds of connected mobile robots.
  • Develop diagnostic tools, monitoring solutions and performance analysis methodologies.
  • Define connectivity KPIs and monitoring strategies to improve fleet reliability.
  • Work alongside Software and Systems teams to improve communication between robots and backend services.
  • Contribute to embedded connectivity software development using C/C++.
  • Design and conduct network testing and validation campaigns in laboratory and real-world environments.
  • Provide advanced networking expertise during customer investigations and deployment activities.


What We're Looking For

  • Master's degree (Bac+5 or equivalent) in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Networking, Embedded Systems or a related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of experience in wireless networking, telecommunications, embedded systems or a similar technical environment.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals.
  • Good knowledge of IEEE 802.11 standards, particularly Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) and Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax).
  • Understanding of wireless security protocols, including WPA2 and WPA3.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting network issues using packet capture and protocol analysis tools.
  • Comfortable working within Linux environments.
  • Experience with network performance testing, monitoring and observability tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in understanding system behaviour in real-world environments.
  • Ability to work across networking, software and hardware disciplines.

Experience with C/C++ and embedded connectivity software would be particularly beneficial.


What's On Offer?

  • Direct involvement in R&D and the development of next-generation robotic technology.
  • A highly collaborative engineering environment working across software, hardware and networking.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
BoomerangFX

Location: Mississauga, Ontario — on-site, five days per week

Reports to: Director of Product Manager and Technology


Mandate Experience


Minimum experience of 6 years in managing end-to-end technical product delivery, bridging business requirements with engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle. Skilled in translating business needs into BRDs, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria while coordinating with engineering, QA, and business stakeholders. Strong technical expertise in .NET Core, C#, React.js, JavaScript, Azure, APIs, and SQL databases, with the ability to lead technical discussions, manage Agile sprints, track Jira deliverables, and drive solutions from requirements through deployment and production validation.


Why Join BoomerangFX?


BoomerangFX is a global healthcare technology company bringing SaaS, artificial intelligence and digital marketing together to help private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program, we are building technology that simplifies practice management, strengthens patient engagement and helps healthcare businesses reach more people.

With operations in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and India, we are scaling internationally and working at the forefront of AI in healthcare. Our teams collaborate across countries and disciplines to turn new ideas into products and services that make a practical difference for customers.


Joining BoomerangFX is an opportunity to build your career alongside a growing global business. You will have meaningful responsibility, exposure to international markets and the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and see the impact of your work. We welcome people who take ownership, move quickly and want to help build what comes next.


The Role


We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who combines strong product and stakeholder-management capabilities with a solid software engineering background.

This is a hands-on technical/product role for someone who can understand and challenge technical discussions, translate business needs into actionable requirements, drive technical meetings, manage delivery, and work closely with engineering, QA, business, and leadership teams.


The ideal candidate has a strong background in .NET/C# development, React, JavaScript, Azure, APIs, and databases, and has transitioned into a product, delivery, or technical leadership role.

You will act as the bridge between business objectives and technical execution, ensuring that teams have clarity on requirements, priorities, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.


Product & Requirements


  • Translate business needs and product objectives into clear, actionable technical requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
  • Monitor Jira dashboards and reports to track sprint progress, velocity, blockers, risks, defects, aging items, and delivery timelines.
  • Work with stakeholders to define priorities, scope, business rules, dependencies, and success criteria.
  • Ensure development, QA, UAT, and production issues are appropriately tracked and progressed through Jira.
  • Identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks early and drive them to resolution.
  • Balance business priorities with technical feasibility, scalability, security, and delivery timelines.


Technical Leadership


  • Lead technical discussions involving architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, application performance, cloud infrastructure, and deployment.
  • Facilitate design and solution discussions between engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Understand the technical implications of product decisions and communicate them clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner with engineering leads to evaluate technical approaches, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Participate in troubleshooting and production issue discussions when required.
  • Ensure technical decisions remain aligned with business objectives.


Delivery & Execution


  • Own product/technical delivery from requirements through development, QA, UAT, production deployment, and post-production validation.
  • Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Track dependencies, risks, blockers, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Work closely with QA to ensure appropriate test coverage and acceptance criteria.
  • Support UAT and production validation when required.
  • Help coordinate production issues and ensure timely resolution.


Stakeholder Management


  • Serve as a key interface between business stakeholders, engineering, QA, product, and leadership.
  • Build trust and effective working relationships across diverse teams.
  • Communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Manage expectations around scope, timelines, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Demonstrate strong judgment, people instincts, and the ability to navigate challenging situations.


Analytical & Problem Solving


  • Analyze complex data and information to identify trends, issues, opportunities, and actionable insights.
  • Use data and evidence to support prioritization and decision-making.
  • Break complex problems into structured, actionable solutions.
  • Make fast, confident decisions in ambiguous situations while proactively seeking feedback


Mandatory Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6-8 years of full-stack development experience, including expertise in:
  • .NET Core, .NET 6 and above, C#
  • SQL Server, MySQL
  • JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React.js, Redux
  • Azure (DevOps, Functions, CI/CD, Azure Boards)
  • Strong understanding of modern software architecture, design patterns, and best practices.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management tools like Jira.
  • Ability to balance hands-on coding with strategic leadership and team management.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical skills, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


Compensation and Benefits


  • Base Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 + 10% annual bonus
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Work Location: This is a 5-day on-site role based in Mississauga, Ontario.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid vacation
  • Free on-site parking


How to Apply


Submit your résumé


Accessibility Statement


BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals for our career opportunities and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you need accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact us at recruitment@boomerangfx.com.

title: REMOTE Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
Reports to: VP of Engineering, Operations
Location: Remote
Primary stack: Python, Kotlin, TypeScript, AWS
AI focus: LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG architectures, evaluation pipelines (Claude/Bedrock integration)

Founded in 2006, we're one of the largest app vendors (300+ employees) supporting 30,000+ customers worldwide - including Amazon, Disney, Dell, PayPal, and Hulu. In fact, one in three Fortune 500 companies relies on our products!!

We are building the intelligence layer that helps product and engineering teams plan, allocate, and act with confidence - turning noisy signals into clear, actionable decisions. You'll join a product team (not an isolated research silo) and ship production AI systems used by real customers.

We're currently growing at a 40% YoY pace and we need your help to keep up with the momentum! We're looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer who will be working at the intersection of LLMs, real-time signal processing, and enterprise decision-making. If you treat AI as a production engineering discipline - not a notebook experiment - this is the role for you.

What you'll be doing

You will design, build, and operate the AI components that make our platform intelligent and trustworthy:

  • Signal & anomaly detection - Build statistical and ML detectors that separate noise from real problems in CDC event streams and external integrations.
  • Insight synthesis engine - Ship an LLM-powered correlation engine that returns root causes, confidence scores, and evidence chains, not just alerts.
  • Planning rules compiler - Translate natural-language planning rules into structured parameters for a deterministic Monte Carlo scheduling engine.
  • Evaluation & testing frameworks - Create regression suites, A/B testing, and confidence-calibration pipelines so model changes are safe and measurable.
  • MCP tool definitions - Define LLM-ready tool specs (Item Store queries, capacity lookups, scenario simulations) for runtime tool use in a hub-and-spoke agent architecture.


What I need from you

  • Proven track record shipping LLM-powered features or products (not prototypes) that real users rely on.
  • Hands-on experience orchestrating agents (multi-step reasoning, tool use, autonomous action with guardrails) - LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
  • Deep LLM engineering fundamentals: prompt design, RAG architectures, function-calling/tool use, context management, and evaluation-driven development.
  • Production engineering discipline: tests, CI/CD, observability, and reliability for production AI systems.
  • Experience with event-driven or streaming systems (CDC, real-time pipelines).
  • 5+ years software engineering, with 3+ years focused on AI/ML in production.
  • Comfortable working embedded in a product team - collaborating daily with domain engineers, product managers, and designers.


Preferred experience

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or GCP Vertex AI (we run on Bedrock with Claude today).
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic frameworks.
  • Background in anomaly detection, time-series analysis, or statistical signal processing.
  • Experience building confidence scoring / calibration systems for AI outputs.
  • Proficiency in Kotlin or TypeScript in addition to Python (our product platform is Kotlin/TypeScript; AI platform is Python).
  • History of absorbing work from external partners and improving inherited architectures.


Nice to have

  • Monte Carlo simulation, optimization, or scheduling systems.
  • Domain experience in portfolio, project, or resource planning.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience (multi-tenancy, compliance, audit trails).
  • Open-source contributions to AI/ML tooling or frameworks.


What we offer

  • Remote work - work where you do your best thinking.
  • Unlimited vacation.
  • Comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision).
  • Great office spaces in Canada and Iceland if you prefer.
  • A collaborative, diverse team and high-impact work - you'll be building the intelligence layer for enterprise portfolio management, not adding AI to a CRUD app.
  • Regular social activities, breakfast/snacks, and more.

title: Senior AI Solutions Lead
description:
Systematix is currently seeking a Senior AI Solutions Lead for our client, a major provincial energy utility organization, to lead the design, development, implementation and ongoing support of enterprise artificial intelligence solutions.


ABOUT THE PROJECT

Systematix is supporting a major Canadian energy utility organization with the delivery of enterprise AI initiatives. The successful candidate will work within the Enterprise Application Services (EAS) team alongside business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Enterprise Security and Project Delivery teams.


The role is predominantly hands-on. The resource will lead AI initiatives from discovery and prioritization through architecture, production implementation, support and measurable benefits realization. The environment includes Azure Foundry, related Azure services, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Databricks, .NET and Python, with AI agents, chatbots, retrieval solutions, enterprise APIs, SDKs, vector indexes and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.


ABOUT THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead AI discovery and scoping, define requirements and acceptance criteria, estimate effort and establish benefits and success measures.
  • Work with business stakeholders to assess, prioritize and deliver AI opportunities.
  • Design solution architectures with Enterprise Architecture, selecting appropriate AI services, SDKs, data access and integration approaches.
  • Develop and implement production AI solutions, including agents, chatbots, retrieval over enterprise information and workflows using enterprise APIs and MCP tools.
  • Write and maintain production code; implement testing, quality evaluations and deployment processes.
  • Coordinate security, permissions, data access and operational readiness with relevant teams.
  • Support deployed solutions, monitor quality, reliability and usage costs, and resolve defects and enhancements.
  • Validate outcomes against agreed business baselines and identify improvements.
  • Maintain technical and operational documentation, transfer knowledge and complete support handover.


REQUIREMENTS – Must-have

  • Minimum 5 years of experience delivering software solutions.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience developing AI solutions.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite at the client head office in Regina, Saskatchewan, Monday to Friday.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving and collaboration skills appropriate to a hands-on technical leadership role.
  • Availability to attend an interview if shortlisted.


Nice-to-have

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical diploma in computer science, information systems, engineering or related discipline.
  • 3+ years developing with C# .NET and 3+ years developing with Python.
  • 2+ years developing and deploying AI solutions using Azure Foundry or a comparable platform.
  • 2+ years building AI agents and chatbots with tool calling, workflow orchestration and enterprise API integration.
  • 2+ years implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector indexes and grounded responses over enterprise information.
  • 2+ years integrating AI services via APIs and SDKs, including authentication, permissions, error handling and testing.
  • 2+ years defining AI quality evaluations and acceptance criteria, including incorrect responses and failed tool actions.
  • 2+ years using Git, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and AI-assisted or agentic development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Codex.
  • 1+ year developing solutions and workflows using ChatGPT Enterprise.
  • 1+ year using or integrating with Databricks.
  • 1+ year developing custom MCP servers or integrating AI solutions with MCP tools and enterprise data services.
  • 2+ years independently leading AI initiatives through discovery, scoping, prioritization, architecture, implementation, support and benefits realization.
  • 2+ years deploying and supporting production AI solutions, including monitoring, usage-cost management and operational handover.
  • 2+ years working with stakeholders to assess value, define benefit measures and evaluate outcomes.
  • North American work experience; energy or utilities industry experience.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: 100% onsite – Regina, Saskatchewan

Start: January 2027

End: March 31, 2028


PAY DISCLOSURE

Intermediate: $95–115/hr

Senior: $115–135/hr

Proposed consultant pay ranges in Canadian dollars. Compensation is commensurate with experience, AI development expertise, enterprise integration capabilities and market conditions. Hourly compensation is intended to be inclusive of applicable travel and living costs associated with the onsite requirement.


AI DISCLOSURE

Systematix may use artificial intelligence (AI) or other automated tools to support portions of our recruitment process. No automated system is used to make hiring decisions.


ABOUT SYSTEMATIX

Systematix is one of Canada's largest privately owned national consulting and resourcing firms. With offices across North America, we deliver high-calibre consulting services and technology professionals to clients across all levels of government and the private sector.

Systematix is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Systematix. Results Focused. People Driven.

title: Enterprise Integration Application Developer
description:
The Enterprise Integration Application Developer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining integration solutions that ensure seamless data exchange between enterprise systems, applications, and external business partners. This includes support for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions and the integration of ERP, CRM, and other critical systems. The role plays a vital part in streamlining business processes, ensuring data consistency, and supporting both internal and partner-facing integration requirements.


Duties:

  • Design, build, and maintain integration solutions between enterprise applications, systems, and databases.
  • Develop and support EDI transactions between the organization and external trading partners.
  • Implement data mapping, transformation, and orchestration processes using integration platforms or middleware.
  • Collaborate with business units, analysts, and system owners to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Monitor integration workflows and EDI transactions to ensure reliability, performance, and data accuracy.
  • Troubleshoot integration and EDI issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure integrations follow security, compliance, and data governance policies.
  • Document integration processes, data flows, partner configurations, and technical solutions.
  • Support onboarding of new trading partners and internal applications into the integration ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with other developers and system analysts for seamless ERP/EDI integration.


Skills:

  • 5+ years of proven experience with EDI systems, transaction sets, and mapping tools.
  • 5+ years of experience with integration platforms and EDI translation software (e.g., Microsoft BizTalk, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, IBM WebSphere, IBM Sterling, Gentran, Seeburger, Cleo, OpenText).
  • Strong Knowledge of ETL tools and processes.
  • Strong understanding of common EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT, TRADACOMS).
  • Proficiency in web services (REST, SOAP), data formats (XML, JSON), and API management.
  • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines in integration projects.
  • Experience with ERP systems integration (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics).
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized.

  • Work on technically challenging, AI-focused products and solutions.

  • Experience with Agentic SDLC, AI-enabled software factories, agent factories, harness engineering, or comparable AI delivery frameworks.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure architecture and implementation experience, including Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, monitoring services, Azure AI Search, and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Experience building tools, connectors, custom APIs, MCP-based solutions, and enterprise integrations.
  • Strong software development experience with C#/.NET or another modern enterprise programming language.
  • Experience developing modern web applications using React, TypeScript, or comparable technologies.
  • Proven ability to take AI solutions from technical discovery and prototyping through production implementation and operational support.
  • Experience architecting reusable platforms and frameworks that support multiple enterprise use cases.
  • Strong customer-facing consulting, technical discovery, and solution architecture experience.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executive stakeholders and translate technical decisions into clear business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, influencing technical teams, and providing architectural leadership without relying exclusively on formal management authority.

  • Strong judgment, curiosity, commercial awareness, and adaptability when working in ambiguous or fast-changing environments.

title: Senior Agentic AI Software Engineer

Senior Agentic AI Software Engineer – Engineering & Component Validation

Company: Sapphire Stream Technology (SST)

Location: Markham, Ontario, Canada

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Sapphire Stream Technology

Sapphire Stream Technology (SST) is a technology and engineering services company delivering software development, system integration, AI solutions, and engineering validation services. We work with leading technology companies to develop, validate, and optimize advanced software and hardware platforms.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Agentic AI Software Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI-powered agents and multi-agent workflows that improve engineering development and component validation.

This role combines strong Python software engineering skills with practical experience in agentic AI, automation, and engineering validation. The successful candidate will build scalable, reliable AI solutions that integrate with existing development tools, testing infrastructure, and engineering workflows.

The position requires hands-on technical expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI Development & Architecture

  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI agents, multi-agent systems, and reusable software services for engineering development and component validation.
  • Translate engineering requirements into automated agentic workflows for test planning, test generation, execution, defect investigation, result analysis, and reporting.
  • Develop scalable Python services, APIs, and reusable libraries for agent orchestration, tool execution, state management, and workflow recovery.
  • Implement LLM-based capabilities, including tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

Engineering Integration & Automation

  • Integrate AI agents with source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, defect-tracking systems, and engineering infrastructure.
  • Develop automation solutions that improve engineering efficiency, software quality, and validation coverage.
  • Build and maintain reliable integrations between AI agents and engineering tools.

Software & Component Validation

  • Design and implement unit, integration, system, and agent-behavior tests to ensure reliability, correctness, traceability, and repeatability.
  • Develop and execute component-validation workflows across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments.
  • Validate functionality, performance, power, and test coverage against engineering requirements.
  • Troubleshoot issues across AI agents, software services, hardware-related components, and validation infrastructure.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.

Security, Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Apply secure AI development practices, including controlled tool execution, data protection, access management, auditability, and human approval controls.
  • Collaborate with software development, component engineering, CQE, and DevOps teams to identify and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish reusable engineering practices and measure improvements in validation efficiency, reliability, and productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Python software development, including APIs, backend services, reusable libraries, and system integrations.
  • Experience designing, developing, and deploying AI agents or LLM-powered applications.
  • Understanding of agent orchestration, LLM tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, and workflow automation.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, system architecture, debugging, automated testing, and code reviews.
  • Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and software development tools.
  • Ability to design reliable software solutions with appropriate testing, error handling, logging, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing AI agents for engineering development, testing, or validation.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
  • Experience validating software across hardware, firmware, device drivers, or AI/ML platforms.
  • Exposure to pre-silicon and post-silicon validation environments.
  • Experience with component-level or system-level validation, including functional, performance, power, and coverage testing.
  • Familiarity with engineering lab infrastructure, automated test environments, and defect-management systems.
  • Knowledge of secure AI deployment, access controls, data protection, and human-in-the-loop approval processes.
  • Experience improving engineering productivity through AI-driven automation.


What We're Looking For

We are looking for a hands-on software engineer who can build production-quality AI agent systems, not just experiment with LLM prompts.

The ideal candidate combines strong Python engineering, practical agentic AI development, and an understanding of software or component validation. They should be comfortable owning solutions from initial architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

title: People Associate - Working Student
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the team

Are you curious about the operational side of HR and ready to start your career in a global tech company? Join our Germany country team as a People Associate Working Student. You'll get hands-on HR experience, work with friendly and ambitious colleagues, and see your work make a difference every day. Based in Berlin, reporting into Team Lead, HR Operations Germany.

What you'll be doing

  • Keep employee documents in order, including personal files (hard copy and electronic).
  • Take care of post-related tasks.
  • Team up with our Office Management team on overlapping topics.
  • Support HR Ops and our People Partner in preparing presentations for different events.
  • Help us set up and improve HR processes and tools.
  • Organize team activities that bring people together.
  • …and most importantly, be yourself and contribute to our team culture.

Our humble expectations

  • Growth-minded: You're willing to learn something new every day.
  • Comms ace: You communicate well, with advanced German and fluent English.
  • Problem solver: You bring a can-do attitude and tackle challenges head-on.
  • Networker: You enjoy connecting with people across teams.
  • Team player: You work well with others.
  • Digitally fluent: You're comfortable with PowerPoint, Excel and Google Workspace.
  • Bonus points: Experience with Workday, Jira and Slack, or with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude.

Why you'll love working with us

  • Real responsibility and ownership from day one.
  • Lots of learning and growth in a high-growth, globally scaling tech company.
  • An ambitious, friendly and humble team.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Sr. Consultant, Advisory Services - Remote
description:

Leading edge technology in an industry that is improving the lives of millions. The Sr. Consultant is a consultant and trusted advisor within Optum Advisory Services.

  • 2+ years of external client-facing consulting experience
  • 2+ years of experience documenting consulting deliverables (e.g., documenting requirements, writing features, user stories, test cases, technical specifications / mapping documents
  • 2+ years of experience creating process flow diagrams
  • 1+ years of experience working with at least one core administration system (ex: Facets, QNXT, Health Rules Payer, Tapestry)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working on at least one end-to-end payer systems and application implementations or migration project
  • Hands-on experience working with Facets
  • Experience with any / all of the following applications: MS Project, Smartsheet, Service Now, Jira, Rally
  • Experience in a Product Owner role
  • Experience working on a cloud migration project
  • Experience using Microsoft Copilot, writing prompts, and creating agents

*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). The salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.
