title: Sr.Analyst-Payments Automation & Analytics
description:
Are you ready to modernize payment operations through automation and analytics? Apply Now!

Working with one of our top financial clients, this role calls for a Sr.Analyst-Payments Automation & Analytics to support payment transformation and modernization initiatives within a specialized portfolio. This 12-month contract offers the opportunity to improve operational efficiency through automation, intelligent reconciliation, test automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions while collaborating with technology, operations, product, risk, compliance, QA, and vendor stakeholders.

Pay rate range (CAD): $43.48/hr – $56.52/hr

Responsibilities

  • Design and optimize automated workflows for payment operations, reconciliation, exception management, and operational controls.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processing through scripting, AI-enabled workflows, and low-code or no-code tools.
  • Develop and maintain automated test cases and regression frameworks for payment systems and operational platforms.
  • Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and reconciliation validation.
  • Investigate payment exceptions, operational variances, and control issues to identify root causes and recommend remediation.
  • Support reconciliation and balancing activities across real-time payments, wire transfers, electronic payments, card payments, ISO messaging, and settlement processes.
  • Develop automated controls, monitoring solutions, dashboards, reports, and operational metrics to identify anomalies and track performance.
  • Analyze payment and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, control gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Translate business requirements into scalable automation, reconciliation, and reporting solutions.

  • Three to seven years of experience in payments operations, reconciliation, exception management, settlement processes, business analysis, automation, QA/testing, or operational transformation.
  • Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, payment flows, settlement, reconciliation, and payment lifecycle management.
  • Experience with electronic payments, ACH, wire payments, card and debit transactions, real-time payments, and ISO 20022 messaging.
  • Strong process automation experience using Python, SQL, Power Automate, Alteryx, UiPath, or similar tools.
  • Experience developing and executing automated testing, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and regression testing.
  • Strong data analytics, reporting, dashboard development, and operational metrics experience.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled solutions and intelligent automation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of operational processes, system integrations, data flows, APIs, and payment processing environments.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify operational inefficiencies, investigate complex issues, and recommend solutions that improve performance and reduce risk.
  • Passion for automation, operational excellence, AI-driven transformation, and continuous improvement within financial services and payments environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Experience working within a leading banking environment.

title: Network Administrator
description:
Position Description

Location: Flexible within Canada. The successful candidate may be based in any city within proximity of a CGI office to accommodate a hybrid work environment.

The GTO Infrastructure Services team is seeking an experienced Network Administrator to support a critical client banking environment.

This role is responsible for the day-to-day administration, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the network infrastructure supporting SCU banking platforms across production, test, and disaster recovery environments. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring network services remain secure, stable, resilient, and available while contributing to the overall success of the client engagement.

Working as part of the broader GTO Infrastructure Services organization, the Network Administrator will collaborate with network engineers, security specialists, infrastructure teams, application support teams, vendors, and client stakeholders to deliver high-quality operational support and continuous service improvement.

This is a hands-on role combining the maintenance and support of a complex enterprise network environment with Microsoft Azure network design and security. It also provides opportunities for professional growth and involvement in modernization and infrastructure improvement initiatives.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Network Operations & Administration

  • Administer and support enterprise network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and related network services.
  • Monitor network health, capacity, utilization, and performance across production and non-production environments.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve network incidents and service disruptions.
  • Participate in major incident response activities and technical escalation processes.
  • Perform root cause analysis and contribute to problem management activities.
  • Maintain network documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.

Change Management & Maintenance

  • Implement network changes in accordance with established change management processes.
  • Support hardware and software lifecycle management activities.
  • Validate network configurations against operational and security standards.
  • Assist with vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security initiatives.
  • Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity exercises.
  • Ensure supported environments remain compliant with operational and security requirements.

Service Delivery & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of operational processes, standards, and procedures.
  • Develop and maintain support documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve stability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Support network automation and standardization initiatives where appropriate.
  • Participate in service reviews and operational reporting activities.

Collaboration & Client Engagement

  • Work closely with infrastructure, server, cloud, security, and application support teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions with internal and client stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Foster strong working relationships across support and delivery teams.

On-Call Support

  • Participate in an after-hours on-call rotation supporting critical business services.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

  • 3+ years of experience in a Network Administrator, Network Operations, or related infrastructure support role.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and securing Microsoft Azure networks. Experience managing VNets, ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, BGP routing, and Azure Firewall.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • TCP/IP networking
  • Routing and switching technologies
  • VLANs and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking
  • DNS and DHCP
  • Network security fundamentals
  • Experience supporting production enterprise network environments, including administering firewall policies, troubleshooting traffic flows, and supporting firewall upgrades and migrations through controlled changes.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Experience working within Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

________________________________________

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with several of the following technologies is considered an asset:

  • Cisco and Juniper switching and routing platforms
  • Check Point firewalls
  • Fortinet firewalls
  • F5 Load Balancers
  • OSPF and BGP routing protocols
  • HSRP and VRRP
  • Firewall policy administration and Access Control Lists (ACLs)
  • WAN, MPLS, and SD-WAN networking, including inter-site connectivity troubleshooting and coordination with telecommunications providers
  • VPN and remote access technologies
  • Network monitoring and alerting platforms
  • Experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep) is preferred
  • High-availability and resilient network architectures

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent industry certification.
  • Experience supporting financial services or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting business-critical infrastructure and applications.
  • Exposure to hybrid cloud and modern networking technologies, including virtualized data-centre networking and network validation during platform migrations: VLAN and subnet mapping, gateways, firewall zones, routing, and target logical networks.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

________________________________________

Success Factors

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • A strong operational support mindset and sense of ownership.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • The ability to remain effective in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • A disciplined approach to change management and documentation.
  • The ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • A commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement.

title: Team Lead, Partner Enablement
description:
Retire The ERP.

At Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.

In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.

You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.

The Role

Light doesn’t implement Light alone anymore. Accounting and consulting firms, from Big 4 practices to regional champions, are building Light implementation practices, and a growing share of our new customers go live through a partner. Our Partner Solutions Architects make sure every one of those deliveries meets Light’s standard. You lead that team, and you own the system that makes partner delivery repeatable at scale.

  • Lead, hire and grow a team of Partner Solutions Architects: set priorities, assign partner portfolios, coach on hard deals, and hold a high bar for quality and pace.

  • Own partner delivery health across the whole ecosystem: one clear view of every partner-led implementation, which are on track, which are drifting, and what you’re doing about it.

  • Own Light’s delivery gates for partner deals and make sure every partner passes them on time and to the right standard.

  • Build and run the partner capacity and delivery forecast: who each partner has, who is certified, what they can take on next, and when. Sales should always be able to tell a customer yes, with a start date we can stand behind.

  • Own the partner enablement path end to end: AI Academy curriculum, instructor-led sessions, bootcamps, sandbox environments and certification. Decide what “Light-certified” means and hold that bar firm.

  • Use AI to scale enablement, so one architect can support many more partner consultants without the quality dropping.

  • Be the senior escalation point for partners and their clients: step in personally on the hardest consolidations, migrations and entity structures, and on partner relationships that need a reset.

  • Work with the Commercial Partnerships Lead on partner selection, tiering and onboarding, so the partners we sign are the partners who can deliver.

  • Feed what the team learns on live deals back into the curriculum, the implementation playbooks and the product roadmap.

  • Report to Light leadership on partner delivery health, capacity, certification and quality, using metrics such as certified consultants per partner, partner-led go-lives on time, and customer satisfaction on partner deals.

How You Fit Into The Team

As Team Lead, Partner Enablement, you sit between our partners, their clients and Light’s own implementation team, and you report directly to the Head of Services. You’ll work daily with the Commercial Partnerships Lead, Implementation, Sales, Data Migration Services and Product.

This is a player-coach role: you lead the team and run the system, and you still take a portfolio of your own and go hands-on when a deal needs it. Your mandate is simple to state and hard to do: every partner-led customer should have an experience as good as one delivered by Light directly.

Your Qualifications Could Be

  • You have been the accountable lead on at least one finance system go-live. This is a must.

  • 7+ years in finance transformation, ERP implementation or finance advisory: Big 4, a finance-focused boutique, or a vendor-side professional services team (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday Financials or similar).

  • 2+ years leading consultants, whether as a line manager or as an engagement or practice lead with a team delivering under you.

  • You’ve managed a portfolio, not just a project: many moving deals, many stakeholders, one clear view of where everything stands.

  • You’re fluent in accounting and can hold your own with a Controller on multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, accruals, and statutory vs management reporting.

  • You’ve trained, coached or certified other consultants, and you know the difference between someone who has been trained and someone who can deliver.

  • You work well through people who don’t report to you, and build trust with partner leadership and client finance teams through clear communication and consistent follow-through.

  • You use AI tools daily, and have specific opinions on where they help in delivery and enablement work and where they don’t.

  • Highly organised and analytical. You like a good forecast, keep clean data, and spot the deal that’s quietly going wrong.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • Commercial instincts: experience in account management, client services, alliances or pre-sales alongside delivery.

  • Experience building a partner, channel or alliance enablement or certification programme from scratch.

  • Time at or with an implementation partner, so you know how partner practices staff, price and run their delivery.

  • Ex-Big 4 (advisory or audit) and a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Multi-jurisdiction experience (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP and local GAAPs).

  • Additional European languages, German especially.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary plus equity.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining motion.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Final Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

If you want to build the team that makes Light’s partners as good as Light, we’d love to hear from you at

Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀

title: Senior Director, UX Product Design - AI & Product Office - Remote or Boston, MA - Remote
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Sr. Director of Design, AI & Product Office brings hands-on product design leadership to Optum Health's enterprise AI and product agenda. Working closely with the Chief AI & Product Officer and a cross-functional product team, this leader identifies the most important problems to solve, shapes AI-enabled experiences around the needs of patients and care teams, and leads a small team of product designers delivering the work.

This is a player-coach role for a design leader who builds. You will set design direction, develop and coach designers, establish practical design standards, and remain directly involved in research, prototyping, testing, and delivery. You will work alongside product, engineering, clinical, service design, deployment, and care teams to understand how care works in practice and turn meaningful problems in care delivery into products people can use and trust.

You will lead experience design across the channels patients and care teams already use and shape how AI behaves in the experience, including what happens when it is uncertain or wrong. You will use AI and modern prototyping tools as part of the design process, work closely with engineers through what ships, and hold the team accountable for measuring whether the experience achieves the outcomes it was designed to achieve.

The AI & Product Office is building a small, cross-functional product team spanning product management, engineering, product design, service design, deployment, and clinical expertise. The team embeds with local Optum Health market teams to identify problems with the people who do the work, then design, build, deploy, and measure products that solve them. What the team learns in the first market becomes the repeatable method for the next.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design Leadership and Team Development
    • Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, creating clear expectations, effective critique, and growth plans that raise the quality and consistency of the work
    • Set the product design vision and operating approach for the AI & Product Office, while staying hands-on in the most complex or highest-risk work
    • Plan and prioritize the design portfolio with product and engineering leaders, matching design capacity to the highest-value problems
    • Build and scale the design team over time, including role definition, interviewing, onboarding, and use of internal or external design partners
    • Create an inclusive team culture that values curiosity, direct feedback, strong craft, evidence-based decisions, and shared accountability for outcomes
    • Represent product design in leadership discussions and clearly communicate user needs, design trade-offs, risks, and recommendations
  • Research
    • Lead research where the work happens by observing and interviewing patients and care team members in clinics, practices, homes, and other care settings
    • Ensure the team includes patients with varied language, literacy, age, disability, and access needs, not only the easiest users to reach
    • Partner with care team members and clinical informaticists as design partners from the first sketch
    • Establish a consistent research cadence and ensure findings are documented, reviewed, and translated into product decisions
    • Coach designers and cross-functional partners in ethical, inclusive, and effective research practices
  • Experience and Product Design
    • Lead end-to-end experience design across electronic health record workflows, SMS, voice, existing portals, and other channels people already use
    • Define how AI features behave, including what an agent says and does, how it shows sources, how a person corrects or overrides it, and what happens when it is wrong or unsure
    • Guide rapid prototyping at the fidelity the question requires, including working prototypes built with AI and code tools, and test them with real users before build
    • Own the design system and experience standards for the team's products, aligned with Optum brand and WCAG accessibility standards, so they can scale across markets
    • Partner with service design so the product, care workflow, operating process, and human handoffs are designed as one experience
    • Maintain direct design ownership for selected strategic initiatives while enabling other designers to independently lead their product areas
  • Delivery, Measurement, and Improvement
    • Define experience, usability, adoption, and outcome measures with product and operations, then review results after launch to determine whether the design changed what it intended to change
    • Ensure designers work alongside engineering through build, launch, and iteration rather than handing off static designs
    • Create quality checkpoints for accessibility, usability, AI trust and safety, and design-system alignment before release
    • Partner with technology, data, security, legal, privacy, compliance, care teams, and other stakeholders so every design is responsible, secure, and enterprise-ready
    • Raise AI fluency across the design team and market teams, including showing care teams how to prototype safely with AI tools
    • Capture and standardize what works so successful product and design methods can be reused in the next market

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience designing end-to-end UX/UI experiences for digital products, including user research, interaction design, prototyping, usability testing, and delivery of production-ready designs across web, mobile, conversational, or workflow-based applications
  • 5+ years of recent experience in the healthcare industry (within the last 3 years) and within a large, complex, matrixed organization
  • 5+ years of experience managing or leading a multidisciplinary design team in a healthcare environment, including hiring, coaching, providing feedback, facilitating critique, and improving the performance of the design team
    Experience leading field research with users in their own settings and translating insights into product decisions
  • Current experience using AI tools in your own work and building with them, such as an agent, automation, large language model experience, or AI-enabled prototype. We will ask about it in the interview
  • Experience setting design direction across multiple initiatives and balancing team leadership with hands-on design contribution.
  • Working knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design for diverse users
  • Working proficiency in Figma or equivalent, GitHub, and AI coding and agent tools
  • Proven portfolio showing shipped work, the research behind it, your role in leading the work, and evidence of what changed after launch (please include)
  • Proven ability to operate at both enterprise and local-market levels and determine where a given decision belongs
  • Proven solid written communication; decisions, findings, standards, and disagreements in this office are documented clearly
  • Proven ability to build cross-functional relationships at all organizational levels and align product managers, engineers, clinicians, operators, and subject-matter experts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing conversational, voice, or SMS experiences

  • Experience establishing or scaling a design system across products or markets

Core Competencies

  • People leadership and coaching
  • Product design strategy and portfolio judgment
  • Hands-on building with AI

  • Rapid prototyping and testing

title: Programmeur (-euse) senior en IA / Senior AI Programmer
description:

Fondée en 2002, notre société s'est imposée dans le genre des jeux de tir avec des titres tels que Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgement and Outriders. En tant que l'un des studios les plus chevronnés dans l'utilisation du moteur Unreal Engine, nous continuons à développer notre expertise et à dépasser les limites du possible dans le domaine du développement de jeux vidéo.

Nos équipes créatives travaillent actuellement sur plusieurs titres captivants : Gears of War: E-Day développé en collaboration avec Microsoft: projet Echo pour KRAFTON; et Lost Rift, une propriété intellectuelle originale que nous développons en interne selon notre modèle d'auto-édition. Nous explorons également de nouvelles plateformes et expériences avec la réalité virtuelle et d'autres projets non annoncés.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience, PCF continue d'explorer de nouveaux horizons. Notre objectif est de combiner notre expertise avec la créativité des talents les plus brillants et les plus avant-gardistes du secteur, afin de créer la prochaine génération de jeux d'action pour les joueurs du monde entier.

Si vous nous rejoignez dans cette aventure, vous aurez la chance de perfectionner votre art, d'élargir vos connaissances et de travailler aux côtés des meilleurs du marché afin de créer des expériences uniques et inoubliables pour les joueurs du monde entier.

People Can Fly is one of the leading independent AAA game development studios. Our international team consists of hundreds of talented individuals working from offices in Poland, the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, as well as remotely across the globe.

Founded in 2002, we made our mark on the shooter genre with titles such as Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, and Outriders. As one of the most experienced Unreal Engine studios in the industry, we continue to expand on our expertise and push the boundaries of what’s possible in game development.

Our creative teams are currently working on several exciting titles: Gears of War: E-Day developed in collaboration with Microsoft; Project Echo for KRAFTON; and Lost Rift, an original IP we are developing in-house under our self-publishing model. We are also exploring new platforms and experiences with VR and other unannounced projects.

With over 20 years of experience, PCF continues to explore new horizons. We aim to combine our expertise with the creativity of the best and most forward-thinking talent in the industry, building the next generation of action games for players worldwide.

If you join us on this journey, you’ll have the chance to perfect your craft, expand your knowledge, and work alongside industry leaders to create unique, unforgettable experiences for gamers everywhere.

Job Description

As a Policy Analyst (Plant Biosecurity), you will provide specialist advice and undertake research into the economic, social and environmental impacts of new and emerging pests, weeds and diseases. description:

PointClickCare is searching for a Principal AI Engineer who will lead and design AI systems across multiple SaaS solutions following our AI Design Patterns, defining technical standards and reusable patterns for reasoning, tool use, and coordinated action. This role will be part of a team which drives enterprise-wide AI enablement by defining strategy, evangelizing adoption, and delivering measurable business impact. It identifies and prioritizes high-value AI use cases, builds scalable AI solutions, and creates playbooks and patterns to accelerate implementation. Through innovation hubs and close collaboration with product, engineering, and operations, the team transforms prototypes into production-ready solutions. Additionally, it invests in talent development, equipping teams with the skills and tools to embed AI across the organization and leads governance of AI solutions across the organization.

To succeed as a Principal AI Engineer at PointClickCare, you need to be highly innovative, creative, accountable, collaborative, and passionate. The Principal AI Engineer partners with cross-functional teams to transition prototypes into secure, observable production solutions and establish playbooks, evaluation frameworks, and platform components to accelerate adoption. Additionally, the Principal AI Engineer mentors' teams and ensures alignment with Responsible AI, security, and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and reference architecture for agentic AI across applications defining org-wide standards for reasoning loops, tool use/function calling, memory, safety, and interoperability.
  • Build and govern reusable platform components—model broker & multi-model routing, orchestration services, evaluation harnesses, prompt/versioning stores, and telemetry—to accelerate adoption across teams.
  • Develop and refine advanced prompting strategies for LLMs.
  • Drive cross-functional roadmaps and integration standards across business teams—setting API/versioning contracts, optimizing LLM/agent cost performance, and mentoring engineers to raise the bar.
  • Establish and evolve evaluation frameworks for LLMs and agentic systems, including offline and online testing methodologies, safety assessments, quality metrics, and business outcome dashboards.
  • Be the go-to Subject Matter Expert (SME) and internal AI expert for relevant enterprise applications, senior leadership, vendors, business partners and internal team members while staying ahead of emerging trends and advising on best practices
  • Identify, prioritize and execute AI use cases with clear business outcomes
  • Be a coach/mentor for other engineers on AI maturity, including performing peer reviews, leading technical knowledge sharing sessions, establishing engineering best practices, approving pull requests and improving the overall quality of the technical solution

Qualifications We Are Looking For

  • Proven leadership shipping agentic AI at scale across multiple products, setting organization wide standards for reasoning loops, tool use/function calling, memory, safety, and interoperability.
  • Must Have - Expertise & Hands-on experience in Agentic AI Tech stack primarily in Microsoft (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Document Intelligence) and Anthropic (Claude Cowork and Claude Code).
  • Must Have - Advanced Python & Java expertise in production systems (testing, packaging, performance profiling) and deep experience extending agent frameworks such as Anthropic, LangChain, and Foundry.
  • RAG/agent data pipeline expertise: document preprocessing (OCR/NER), chunking strategies, embeddings, vector stores, and data quality/versioning—with evaluation of harnesses for quality, cost, and latency
  • Extensive knowledge and understanding of enabling and maturing AI in a SaaS landscape.
  • Model serving and cost/perf optimization: experience with model broker patterns, multi-model routing, and serving stacks
  • Must Have - knowledge of relational databases (e.g. Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience using system and performance monitoring tools (e.g. AppDynamics, Kibana, OpenTelemetry)
  • BSc/BA in Computer Science or a related degree

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AWS/Azure cloud services or equivalent

  • On-call experience with production grade systems

description:

Location: Markham, ON L3T 7X6

Duration: 12 Months

Job Type: Temporary Assignment

Work Type: Onsite

Pay Rate: $ 55.00-60.00/ Hr


Overview:


TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients world-wide. This Client is an American multinational semiconductor company based in Santa Clara, California, that develops computer processors and related technologies for business and consumer markets. Global company that specializes in manufacturing semiconductor devices used in computer processing. The company also produces flash memories, graphics processors, motherboard chip sets, and a variety of components used in consumer electronics goods.



Job Description:

THE ROLE:

  • As a key member of our Business Enterprise Applications team with focus within our IT Global Operations & Supply Chain team, you will use your expert software engineering skills to develop product security.
  • When you join our passionate and engaged team, you will notice right away we are committed to success.
  • In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing the performance of systems that impact Client product life cycle and modifying to improve the quality of the generated code.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop code, unit test, debug, and implement requests for programs, small projects, and system changes in a custom application environment with a focus on product security.
  • Assist in the development and documentation of system architecture, designs, and consult on encryption management solutions.
  • Analyze and improve performance of the infrastructure and applications.
  • Work with eco-system partners to help improve the security of the entire compute base from CPU to GPU.
  • Very good communicator, able to engage and effectively respond to diverse stakeholders.
  • Support global business users to ensure enterprise applications SLAs are met.
  • Work both independently and as part of a strong, collaborative, and global team.
  • Self-starter who requires minimal supervision.
  • Able to proactively support team culture that fosters knowledge sharing, excellence, and collaboration.
  • Since the position entails working with confidential information, a high level of integrity is required.

Preferred Experience:

  • Extensive software development experience in Java, .Net, C++, Python, SQL, UNIX/Linux.
  • Web & mobile application development, Tomcat, JBoss or WebSphere.
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture systems and concepts, including CPU architecture, fundamentals of the system memory hierarchy and caches, and underlying system hardware and firmware.
  • Knowledge of existing hardware architectures (prefer x86 and/or ARM) including associated security and/or virtualization extensions.
  • Must possess an understanding of all aspects of data, client/server and network security, including firewall administration, encryption technologies and network protocols.
  • Experience with firmware, APIs, applications, OSes and their interactions within Windows, Linux, gaming, compute, and virtualization environments.
  • Eagerness and ability to quickly learn new concepts.
  • Worked in cross-site and matrix environments.
  • Database development, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server.
  • Possess fundamental knowledge of security principles and properties, including confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, authorization, and auditing.
  • Understand industrial security standards: TCG, DMTF, OCP, NIST, FIPS, Common Criteria, etc.
  • Working knowledge of cryptography and encryption key management is an asset.
  • Relevant industry experience is highly beneficial.

Academic Credentials:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Systems Security or related field strongly preferred.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Oncology Biometrics
description:
About the company:

Our client is a global, science-driven biopharmaceutical company (top 10 worldwide)

focused on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines and

healthcare solutions that improve patients’ lives. They are heavily investing in AI and

are building advanced Agentic AI solutions to accelerate scientific research and

decision-making across the organization.


Brief Job Profile Description

The role holder designs, builds, and owns AI agent workflows that run in real business processes for Oncology Biometrics, working within the AI Strategy and Innovation (OBM AI) team. Takes workflows from prototype to monitored, evaluated production services with a usable front end, and is accountable for their reliability, cost, and performance after release. Will mentor junior engineers and work with a cross-functional network of technical experts to deliver reliable, compliant AI solutions.


Typical Accountabilities

  • Design agent and multi-agent workflows end to end, including task decomposition, state and memory, tool design, routing, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Build production backend services (Python, FastAPI), RAG pipelines, and MCP/API integrations with enterprise systems, and deliver the user-facing application, directly or with front-end engineers, including human review-and-approve steps.
  • Build evaluation and observability for each workflow (evaluation sets, quality metrics, regression testing, tracing, cost and latency monitoring) and apply guardrails against hallucination, prompt injection, and tool failure.
  • Deploy and operate services in production (containers, CI/CD, cloud), optimize model choice and routing for cost and latency, and follow up on incidents.
  • Deliver to GxP-aware standards, including traceability, audit trails, access control, versioned prompts and models, validation-supporting documentation, and human review, in line with AstraZeneca standards, responsible AI, and data privacy requirements.
  • Review code and designs, mentor junior engineers, and contribute reusable components and patterns to the wider team.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Essential: Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline; 4–7+ years of software engineering, including 1–3 years building LLM or agentic systems; has shipped at least one agentic workflow into production use in a real business process (real users, operated after launch) and can describe what broke; deep, hands-on Python; production experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or an equivalent framework, RAG, and LLM APIs; demonstrated evaluation and observability practice; experience deploying services (containers, CI/CD, cloud); practical understanding of GxP-aware delivery.
  • Hands-on agentic AI experience. Someone who has built application with agent workflows, using tools such as Claude Core or Codex, and can help design and build our internal AI systems
  • Leadership: Someone who has led application development or small engineering team, working closely with business stakeholders.
  • Desirable: Fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), model routing, or multimodal agents; Kubernetes and a major cloud AI service (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI); React/Next.js and TypeScript; knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and computer system validation; clinical or statistical data experience (SAS/R/Python, CDISC); open-source contributions to agent or evaluation tooling.

Key Relationship to Reach Solutions

  • Internal: OBM AI Strategy and Innovation leadership and engineering team; Biometrics process owners and users of the workflows; R&D IT; Enterprise AI; Oncology Data Science & AI; Quality and Compliance Teams
  • External: AI and technology vendors and external service providers; open-source and developer communities

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

As an AI/ML Engineer at Optum, you will join an innovative engineering team dedicated to modernizing healthcare delivery and advancing health equity through artificial intelligence and intelligent automation. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade AI and machine learning solutions, leveraging state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and secure cloud platforms. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to automate complex workflows, implement robust retrieval-augmented generation systems, and build scalable, secure AI platforms that empower clinicians, operations, and members.

You will enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy production-ready Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) solutions in Python, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and core services into secure cloud platforms
  • Build and maintain resilient agentic workflows using LangGraph and related frameworks to orchestrate multi-step LLM interactions, tool calling, state management, and human-in-the-loop review patterns
  • Implement advanced LLM integration patterns, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vector databases and document ingestion pipelines grounded in enterprise data
  • Establish comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks (both offline and online) to track quality metrics, latency, operational costs, and regression detection for models, prompts, and workflows
  • Drive MLOps and model lifecycle management best practices, encompassing model selection, versioning, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and secure endpoint and secret management
  • Ensure all technical solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, cloud design patterns, and platform-level security controls to mitigate operational and security risks
  • Apply responsible AI and data governance practices, incorporating privacy-by-design, bias mitigation, explainability, hallucination safeguards, and prompt-injection defense into all AI systems
  • Automate repetitive tasks, streamline operational processes, define application performance metrics, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to drive continuous technical innovation

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) development, including model integration, evaluation, and production deployment
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development and AI engineering experience using Python
  • 1+ years of experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), including tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  • 1+ years of experience orchestrating multi-step LLM workflows and agentic patterns using LangGraph or similar frameworks

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience (e.g., 4+ years of software development or AI/ML engineering experience)
  • Experience deploying, scaling, and monitoring AI/ML solutions in enterprise cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Hands-on experience with containerization, orchestration, and CI/CD tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with enterprise data governance, privacy-by-design standards, and responsible AI framework evaluation tools
  • Experience delivering software and AI solutions within healthcare, health insurance, or other highly regulated environments

*All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $98,500 - $176,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
About Us:
Headquartered in Ottawa, BTA Design serves the electronic design community in Canada, specializing in ASIC and FPGA design and verification, and embedded software development services. We augment and enhance our clients’ teams and accelerate the development of complete designs.

We’re adaptable and efficient, with a brilliant staff at our core. We aim to be the best at what we do.

Our success continues to fuel growth. We are currently searching globally for a number of key technical resources, including a Senior Firmware Engineer with exceptional technical skills and significant experience.

About the Position:
As a Senior Firmware Engineer you will play a key role in developing firmware and embedded software for processor-based systems, SoCs and custom silicon; work with hardware, RTL, verification and systems teams from architecture and pre-silicon development through platform bring-up, validation and production support. You will work within a strong and very experienced team and play an integral role in delivering world-class ASICs for our clients.

This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define firmware architecture, hardware/software interfaces, register maps and initialization sequences.
  • Develop and maintain embedded C/C++ firmware, device drivers, board support packages and low-level APIs.
  • Implement and debug interrupts, DMA, shared memory, inter-processor communication and synchronization.
  • Support boot flows, board and silicon bring-up, peripheral integration and hardware/software co-validation.
  • Diagnose system failures and performance issues using register-level instrumentation, logs and debugging tools.
  • Create tests and automation, review code and document interfaces, design decisions and validation results.
Key Qualifications:
  • Substantial hands-on firmware or embedded software development experience with strong C/C++ skills.
  • Practical knowledge of embedded processors, memory-mapped I/O, interrupts and hardware/software interactions.
  • Experience with bare-metal, RTOS or embedded Linux development and associated build and debug tools.
  • Ability to read hardware specifications and investigate issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
  • Experience with platform bring-up, integration testing and reliable delivery of production software.
  • Clear technical communication and the ability to own deliverables and collaborate with client teams.
Additional Qualifications:
  • Boot ROM, secure boot, image authentication and security-processor integration.
  • Virtual platforms, processor models, emulation or simulation-based firmware development and verification.
  • Multicore SoCs, ARM, RISC-V or other embedded architectures; BSPs, QNX or other RTOS environments.
  • High-speed interfaces, networking, multimedia, memory subsystems, functional safety or technical leadership.
Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Why Work Here?
We offer interesting work in challenging, stimulating technical environments with companies that lead the world in technology and innovation.

We recognize that our strength is in the individuals who join our team, so at BTA Design Services, we foster an environment where everyone is appreciated, trusted and engaged. We recognize that work-life balance is important and we strive to provide our employees with challenging roles that also allow them to enjoy family, friends and life outside of work.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)
description:
🚀 We're hiring: AI Engineer | Downtown Toronto (Hybrid) | Full-Time


A well-established global financial services company is expanding its enterprise AI platform. It's hiring a Senior AI Engineer to join a small, hands-on team. You'll design, ship and run production LLM services used by teams across the business, with modern AI coding tools at the centre of how you work.


AI-assisted development is the default here. You'll use Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and the latest models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google every day, from the first prototype to debugging in production. You'll also help decide how the team gets the most out of these tools while keeping code quality high.


What you'll work on

  • Python and Go services that call LLMs through Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or similar, including multi-step agent workflows
  • Full ownership of each service, from data model and logic to APIs and deployment on Kubernetes
  • Evaluation pipelines and test sets that catch problems in model output before users see them
  • Tracing and dashboards that show the cost, latency and output quality of every LLM call
  • Secure multi-tenant design covering permissions, authentication and usage limits
  • Clear technical write-ups of your architecture choices


What you'll need

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, with recent production LLM work
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Copilot or Cursor
  • Strong Python or Go, and experience building agents with an Anthropic, OpenAI or Google SDK
  • Solid skills in prompting, tool and function calling, structured outputs and context management
  • Test-first habits and good judgment about design patterns
  • Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud observability (Azure is a plus)


Bonus: agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel), MCP, Langfuse or similar LLM tracing, RAG and vector search, React or Angular, and a financial services background.

title: Software Firmware Engineer - Bowman
description:
Build bold. Deliver impact. Win together.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, we’re not just engineering technology — we’re shaping the future of defence and security. Our teams design and deliver advanced, mission-critical solutions that enhance national security, strengthen communities, and protect the people we serve.

If you’re looking for meaningful work that contributes to a safer, more secure world, you’ll find purpose here. Every day, your skills will directly impact programs that matter.



Job Description

We are currently seeking an experienced Software/Firmware Developer to join our BOWMAN product development team in Calgary, Alberta.

BOWMAN is an advanced tactical communications system that integrates secure digital voice and data technologies to provide reliable communications in complex military environments. The system brings together radio, telephone, intercom and tactical internet services into a flexible, fully integrated solution that supports critical operations.

As part of the BOWMAN development team, you will help design, develop and enhance the software and firmware capabilities that power this mission-critical system. Your work will contribute to a wide range of communications services, including tactical radio networks, data routing and forwarding, headquarters communications, battle management, system management and IT services.

Working within a multidisciplinary Agile team, you will collaborate with software developers, systems engineers and integration specialists to deliver new features, improve system performance and resolve technical challenges throughout the product development lifecycle.

If you're passionate about developing complex software solutions, enjoy working close to the hardware and want to see your work contribute to real-world defence capabilities, we encourage you to apply.

As a Software/Firmware Developer, you will:

  • Software & Firmware Development: Design, develop, implement and unit test software and firmware components using C++, C# and C to support new capabilities, enhancements and defect resolutions.
  • Technical Design: Review and interpret system and subsystem requirements, interface control documents, technical designs and use cases to develop effective software solutions.
  • Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in Scrum activities, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
  • Development Planning: Contribute to the estimation, refinement and planning of product backlog items and sprint deliverables.
  • Testing & Quality: Develop and execute unit tests, support test-driven development practices and ensure software meets performance, reliability and quality expectations.
  • Systems Integration: Collaborate with systems engineering and product integration teams to support the integration and verification of software and firmware components.
  • Problem Solving: Investigate software defects, troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis and implement effective corrective solutions.
  • Technical Reviews: Participate in design reviews, code reviews and peer discussions to ensure technical quality, maintainability and alignment with system requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle to deliver integrated communication capabilities.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve software performance, development practices and engineering processes.
  • Customer Support: Provide technical expertise during integration, testing and customer activities, with occasional travel as required.

Qualifications

What You Need to Have to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software and/or firmware development.
  • Strong programming skills in C++, C# and C, with experience designing, developing, debugging and maintaining complex software applications.
  • Experience developing software in Linux and Windows environments.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles, software architecture and design methodologies.
  • Experience with UML, software modelling and technical design documentation.
  • Experience developing and executing unit tests, including familiarity with test-driven development practices.
  • Working knowledge of Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and communication protocols, including TCP/IP, UDP and IPv4.
  • Experience with networking technologies and protocols such as VLANs, OSPF, RIPv2, BGP4, DHCP, DNS or DSCP.
  • Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Ability to manage assigned technical deliverables and contribute effectively in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.



Additional Information

The hiring range for this position is $90,000 to 105,000

Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

  • Relevant experience
  • Technical and non-technical skills
  • Education and certifications

Benefits

As a full-time employee at General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, you’ll enjoy a competitive total rewards package that supports your professional and personal well-being:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and eligible dependents from day one (no cost), including flexible benefits options (HCSA) emergency travel insurance, and 24/7 virtual care services.
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP), onsite fitness facilities, and employee resource groups.
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan with employer contributions after 3 months, RRSP access from day one, and financial planning support.
  • Flexible time off including vacation, holidays, parental leaves with top-up options, sick leave, and disability programs.
  • Career development through learning platforms, educational assistance, mentoring, and reimbursement of professional memberships.
  • Additional perks such as employee discounts, free onsite parking, social clubs, and an annual scholarship program for employees’ children.



Why join us?

  • Purposeful Innovation: You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
  • Connection: We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world-class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensures every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
  • Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways: Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network. You’ll be working on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and allow you to both learn from mentors and guide others along the way.

Accommodation

If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact Human Resources via recruitment@gd-ms.ca.

Closing Date

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

title: Vice President, Finance - T&D Infrastructure
description:

Reporting directly to the Segment Vice President, Finance, the Vice President, Finance (T&D Infrastructure) will serve as a key financial advisor to the Division President (T&D Infrastructure) and will be responsible for the accounting, financial reporting & controls, financial planning & analysis, operations, and commercial finance support for the T&D Infrastructure businesses. Willingness to dive deep into the details while keeping an eye on the bigger picture will be critical to finding creative solutions and providing insights and recommendations to business partners. In addition to leading and developing a team of finance and accounting professionals across the T&D Infrastructure strategic business unit, an important aspect of this role is to partner with the various enterprise and segment shared service organizations to ensure accurate, timely, reliable financial accounting and reporting and a collaborative approach. #LI-AO1

A Day In The Life

  • Serve as a financial advisor and trusted business partner to the Division President, T&D Infrastructure, and the related leadership team.

  • Partner with key stakeholders to work on and support T&D Infrastructure strategic plan.

  • Oversee all aspects of finance operations for the T&D Infrastructure strategic business unit, including accounting, financial reporting & controls, financial planning & analysis, and operations and commercial finance.

  • Ensure proper design and operational effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting.

  • Lead and manage the annual financial planning process, as well as the monthly and quarterly forecasting process and monthly and quarterly financial closes.

  • Develop appropriate tracking methods and analytical models surrounding orders, revenue, margins, expenses, manufacturing production spending & variances, cash flow and other key performance measures.

  • Support and track ongoing productivity initiatives, capital expenditures, restructuring initiatives, strategic investments in new product innovation, as well as other key areas.

  • Serve as champion for SAP implementations across the T&D Infrastructure businesses.

What will help you thrive in this role?

  • Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) in Accounting or Finance

  • CPA, CMA and/or MBA preferred

  • 15+ years of finance and accounting positions of increasing responsibility

  • Supervisory / managerial experience

  • Demonstrates executive presence and proven ability to communicate efficiently and effectively across various levels of the organization.

  • Strong knowledge of technical accounting, cost accounting, financial reporting, financial modeling, financial analysis, budgeting and forecasting, and strategic planning, capital planning, productivity management

  • SAP experience a strong plus.

  • Self-reliant, excellent problem solver, results oriented

  • Energetic, flexible, collaborative, and proactive

  • Strong analytical skills, advanced Excel skills, PowerPoint, Power BI data visualization experience

  • Strong written, verbal communications and PowerPoint presentation skills

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work in a team environment

  • Must be flexible for travel as needed; estimate approximately 20% to 40% travel requirement.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $238,500 - $285,300. Final pay will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience, skills, qualifications and work location and may vary accordingly.

Hubbell offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

Medical, dental, life and disability insurance, and supplemental benefits.
401(k) Retirement Plan with company provided 4% automatic contribution and a Company match of 50% on employee contributions up to 6%.
11 employer-paid holidays, flexible vacation, 40 hours sick time, and 8 paid volunteer hours.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

title: Junior Computer Vision Engineer - AOI
description:
About DaoAI

DaoAI Robotics builds AI-native Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems for SMT/EMS electronics manufacturing. Our SMT AOI system is already running on customer production lines, inspecting component placement and solder quality inline on PCBA lines. We're in a phase of fast iteration, and we're growing the team. We fully embrace AI-assisted development: the team uses code agents such as Claude Code and Codex every day.

The Role

You'll join the vision algorithm team and work on real production data and real inspection problems, with a senior engineer as your mentor. You start with well-scoped pieces of the inspection pipeline — data, training, evaluation, failure analysis — and take on more ownership as you grow.

This is a full-time role for new graduates and engineers with 0–2 years of experience. We expect you to grow into owning a full inspection capability within your first year.

What You'll Do

  • Implement and improve PCB/PCBA inspection algorithms in one or more areas: component detection and localization, segmentation, defect classification, character recognition, anomaly detection.
  • Build and maintain datasets: curate and clean production images, apply labeling rules, and review label quality.
  • Train and evaluate models, run controlled experiments, and report results clearly with numbers.
  • Analyze false calls and escapes from customer lines, find the root cause, and turn each one into a fix or a regression test.
  • Write classical image-processing code (alignment, template matching, measurement) alongside deep-learning models, and build small tools for visualization and evaluation.
  • Work with the software team on model export, integration, validation and field-issue debugging.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. New graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome.
  • Solid deep-learning vision fundamentals and at least one project where you trained and evaluated a model yourself in PyTorch (detection, segmentation, classification or anomaly detection) — coursework, thesis, internship or industry all count.
  • Working knowledge of classical computer vision with OpenCV: filtering and morphology, template matching, geometric transforms, basic fitting.
  • Evaluation discipline: you understand precision and recall, know how to build a trustworthy test set, and can explain why a model got a sample wrong.
  • Good Python and Git habits; hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.).
  • Curiosity and ownership: you dig into failure cases until you understand them, and you check your numbers before you report them.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to industrial inspection, PCB/PCBA, AOI/SPI or SMT processes and common defects (insufficient/excess solder, bridging, tombstoning, misalignment, missing parts, reversed polarity).
  • Deployment experience: ONNX, TensorRT, quantization, or C++ inference.
  • Experience with OCR, few-shot/unsupervised anomaly detection, or vision foundation models.
  • Publications, open-source contributions or competition results.

Why Join

  • Your models run on real factory lines, and you see the impact directly.
  • Direct mentorship from a small, senior team with an AI-first engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to the full stack: deep learning, classical vision and production systems.

Salary: CA$60,000 per year. Location: Vancouver, BC (Hybrid). Full-time.

title: Senior Brand Designer (12 month FTC)
description:
A little about us

is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

We're looking for a brilliant Brand Designer who knows B2B SaaS, moves fast, and can make great work happen without a lot of fuss.

What that looks like day to day

We're looking for an experienced Brand Designer to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave.

Our brand design function was built from scratch over the last two years and the foundations are strong - a visual identity, an events design system, SEV0, a rolling drumbeat of launches and campaigns. This isn't a holding-pattern role. You'll take what we've built and run with it, across our website, social, events, launches and our flagship conference. Where you see something that should be better, you'll be trusted to make it better.

We're looking for someone who's done this kind of work before, ideally for ambitious B2B SaaS startups or established software brands. You'll have great creative instincts, an eye for the details and, crucially, the ability to get brilliant work out the door quickly. We move fast, priorities can change, and there's always something new around the corner. You'll know when to sweat the small stuff and when to just get things done.

You'll sit day-to-day in Marketing and be part of the wider Design team, alongside experienced Product Designers who'll be on hand to partner on web-native work.

  • Own brand design across all touchpoints - website, social, ads, guides, reports, events and swag - keeping quality and consistency high through a busy launch and campaign calendar.

  • Design and roll out launch creative for product launches, including launch video animation and campaign assets, partnering with Product Designers on product-screen work.

  • Lead the design for our events programme, including our flagship conference SEV0 - booths, banners, printed collateral, swag and the event design system.

  • Keep things moving - juggle multiple projects, turn around great work quickly and know how to prioritise when everything feels important. We're a fast-moving startup, and we need someone who can keep up without compromising on craft.

  • Be an advocate for consistency and craft as we scale and grow the brand. You'll have the judgement to know when something needs more attention and when it's ready to go.

  • Partner with the marketing team on both tactical and long-term projects, bringing your own perspective on how we should develop our brand.

  • Collaborate with the wider design team as we know an amazing product is the foundation for a great brand, and compelling design can be the foundation for both.

Who you are

  • You've got solid B2B SaaS experience. You've designed for B2B software companies before, whether in-house, freelance or on a contract basis. Ideally, you've worked with established SaaS brands or fast-growing startups, and you understand how to make complex, technical products feel exciting and accessible.

  • Your portfolio speaks for itself. You've got exceptional brand and marketing design work to show us, including websites, campaigns, launches, guides and presentations for B2B SaaS audiences. You care about the little details and know how to make a brand feel brilliant across every touchpoint.

  • You move fast and get stuff done. You've worked in fast-paced environments, ideally startups, and know how to balance speed with quality. You're pragmatic, comfortable juggling competing priorities and don't need everything perfectly mapped out before getting started.

  • You're confident picking up an established brand. You don't need to rebuild things from first principles to make an impact. You can get up to speed quickly, understand what's working and find ways to make it even better.

Working closely with Project Management, Construction, Project Controls, Supply Chain, Finance, People, HSE, IT, Facilities, and other project functions, you will ensure field administration services remain aligned with changing workforce levels, construction priorities, and project requirements.

You will lead and develop a multidisciplinary administrative team while managing service providers, budgets, equipment, and workplace resources to deliver responsive support at the appropriate cost and service level.

You will be responsible for\:

  • Leading daily field administration and office services activities for a large industrial construction site.
  • Establishing priorities, workloads, service expectations, and work processes that support project and construction requirements.
  • Developing and maintaining procedures for document processing and retention, timekeeping support, mail and courier services, office equipment, purchasing support, and facilities administration.
  • Ensuring administrative services remain responsive to changing workforce levels, construction schedules, mobilization activities, and project priorities.

Multicultural, innovative and ambitious, Legos aims to become the number 1 converged operator by breaking down the boundaries of telecoms.

Agile and positioned in Carriers segments, Legos is growing fast.

Joining us means participating in a strong human experience and a meaningful business project !

As a Senior Telecom engineer, the candidate will join the Engineering team and report to the Engineering Director.


About the Engineering team

The Engineering team is responsible for the design, architecture, and infrastructure of the Legos platform: backbone and network core, OSS, BSS, and R&D.

Its mission is to design the systems and to improve them.

Engineering gets involved when the design of a system must be modified and to build new products/services.


🚀Key Responsibilities

The Senior Telecom Engineer's core responsibilities will be to lead engineering projects in three focus areas:

  • Resilience and redundancy: design masking and workaround scenarios and add the missing redundancies through a more resilient architecture
  • Capacity planning and network architecture: anticipate growth and design the evolutions of the infrastructure and of the network architecture accordingly
  • Keeping the platform up to date: plan and drive the migrations and upgrades of systems and virtualization environments (VMware ESX, Proxmox)

  • Continue the migration to Proxmox

  • Customer onboarding, alongside the Customer Journey team
  • Customer support, in assistance of Customer Operations team


Within the Engineering team, the Senior Telecom Engineer will act as:

  • A reference for reproductible infrastructure (infrastructure as code, documentation, least privilege)


Within the technical teams, the Senior Telecom Engineer will regularly be required to:

  • Take part in the on-call duty
