title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Wolt powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Berlin team. In this role, you'll drive high-quality decision-making to maximise impact.

We're hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Data Science Organisation

We have an outstanding Data Science organisation, with a mission to drive the highest quality decision-making across our marketplace. We work throughout the company, in product, operations, and platform teams and are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Wolt. We are great communicators, and move fast to serve our customers a little better every day.

Our community is highly active, and Data Scientists can progress equally as IC leads or managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science; many are not.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the front lines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Our humble expectations

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science position.
  • Expertise in statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing and experimentation (A/B testing and causal inference) using statistical software packages in Python, R, or equivalent for product development.
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets.
  • Prior experience building intuitive data visualizations and dashboards that influence business decisions, utilizing tools like Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Clear and concise communication with strong cross-functional partnership experience.
  • Relentless pursuit of new ideas and data sources, and the ability to systematically tackle ambiguous problems with a data-driven, hypothesis-based approach.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English.

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Helsinki or Stockholm. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the locations above 💙
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Product+ Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via -----

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Applied AI Engineer – Agents & Automation
description:
Position Summary

The Frontier AI Deployed Engineer is a member of Future Electronics' AI & Automation Center of Excellence and works directly with business and technology teams to discover, design, build, and deploy AI-enabled solutions that transform how work gets done across the organization.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role combining applied AI, agentic systems, AI-assisted software development, intelligent automation, enterprise integration, and business process transformation. Frontier Deployed Engineers move beyond experimentation by rapidly transforming ideas into working prototypes and evolving successful concepts into secure, scalable, and production-ready enterprise solutions.

We are looking for AI-native engineers who use AI as a primary force multiplier throughout the engineering lifecycle. Successful candidates actively use tools such as Claude to accelerate research, discovery, solution design, prototyping, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate is an exceptional communicator who is naturally curious, willing to explore unfamiliar technologies, and comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces. This individual knows how to collaborate effectively with AI while applying strong engineering judgment to validate AI-generated designs, code, tests, and recommendations.


Key Responsibilities

Discover & Transform

  • Partner directly with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Sales Operations, Procurement, Customer Service, and other corporate functions to identify high-value opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Understand how work is performed, including workflows, decisions, data dependencies, pain points, exceptions, and operational constraints.
  • Use AI-assisted research and analysis to accelerate business discovery, identify patterns, and explore potential solutions.
  • Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work can be performed using AI.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions and translate business challenges into actionable technical opportunities and measurable success criteria.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on business value, feasibility, scalability, data readiness, risk, and strategic alignment.

Explore & Innovate

  • Use Claude and other AI tools to rapidly translate business problems into technical concepts, prototypes, and experiments.
  • Explore multiple AI-assisted approaches before committing to a solution architecture or technology.
  • Rapidly evaluate emerging AI tools, models, agent capabilities, development methods, and integration patterns.
  • Build working prototypes to validate business assumptions, technical feasibility, user value, and implementation risks.
  • Compare alternative approaches based on quality, security, maintainability, performance, cost, delivery speed, and scalability.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to test new approaches rather than relying exclusively on established technologies or familiar patterns.
  • Share experiments, lessons learned, reusable components, and emerging best practices with the broader team.

Build AI Solutions

  • Apply an AI-first engineering approach, using AI wherever it can materially accelerate solution discovery, architecture, development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and delivery.
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, copilots, assistants, knowledge solutions, and decision-support tools.
  • Apply Generative AI, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector search, document intelligence, natural language processing, tool calling, and related technologies to real business problems.
  • Design agentic workflows that connect AI capabilities, enterprise systems, automation platforms, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Use AI-assisted development to accelerate coding, test creation, code review, refactoring, debugging, technical documentation, and solution optimization.
  • Evaluate and optimize AI solutions for grounding, accuracy, reliability, security, performance, latency, consumption, and operating cost.
  • Validate AI-generated code, designs, tests, and recommendations before incorporating them into production solutions.
  • Apply strong software-engineering principles to transform successful experiments into maintainable and production-ready solutions.

Deploy & Integrate

  • Integrate ERP, CRM, HRIS, supply chain, procurement, eCommerce, ticketing, collaboration, and internal systems through APIs and modern integration technologies.
  • Develop practical solution designs covering applications, AI services, data flows, integrations, identity, security, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Build reusable components, data pipelines, services, connectors, prompts, agent tools, and integration patterns that can scale across the organization.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and Application teams to move solutions safely into production.
  • Apply appropriate source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and operational-support practices.
  • Monitor deployed solutions and continuously improve their reliability, effectiveness, performance, cost, and user experience.

Demonstrate AI-Enabled Delivery Acceleration

  • Demonstrate how AI-first engineering can reduce the time and effort required to move from a business problem to a working solution.
  • Compare AI-first and conventional development approaches when appropriate to identify differences in speed, effort, quality, maintainability, and cost.
  • Establish delivery baselines and track indicators such as time to first prototype, engineering effort, iteration cycles, defects, rework, time to production, and cost to deliver.
  • Document where AI materially accelerated delivery and where conventional engineering or additional human validation remained necessary.
  • Share practical examples and working demonstrations that help the organization understand how AI changes the solution-development lifecycle.
  • Identify repeatable AI-assisted engineering practices that can be adopted by other technology teams.

Drive Adoption & Business Value

  • Work directly with users throughout discovery, prototyping, validation, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts, opportunities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support pilots, user-validation exercises, training, adoption, and feedback activities.
  • Establish business baselines and measure improvements in productivity, quality, cycle time, user adoption, cost, and other relevant outcomes.
  • Ensure technology deployment results in measurable improvements to how work is performed, rather than simply introducing a new technology.
  • Help business teams understand when AI is appropriate, when it requires human oversight, and when a conventional technology solution may be more suitable.

Governance, Security & Responsible AI

  • Ensure solutions align with company security, privacy, compliance, data-governance, and change-management requirements.
  • Apply Responsible AI practices throughout solution design, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Implement appropriate identity, authorization, logging, traceability, human oversight, and data-protection controls.
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to inaccurate AI output, prompt injection, inappropriate data exposure, excessive permissions, unintended automated actions, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Ensure confidential or restricted company information is only processed using approved tools, models, environments, and access controls.
  • Maintain human accountability for AI-assisted engineering decisions and production releases.
  • Participate in security reviews, risk assessments, audits, and production-readiness activities.


Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  • Minimum five years of experience in software engineering, solution development, systems integration, automation, data engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience using Claude for AI-assisted engineering activities such as research, solution design, prototyping, software development, testing, troubleshooting, analysis, or technical documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate delivery while independently validating generated designs, code, tests, and technical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience applying Generative AI, AI copilots, intelligent agents, LLMs, or related technologies to real-world business or technical challenges.
  • Experience taking business-critical technology solutions from concept or prototype into production.
  • Strong programming skills using Python, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, or comparable modern development languages.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, databases, cloud application development, source control, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software-engineering practices.
  • Ability to evaluate when an AI-first development approach is appropriate and when conventional engineering methods remain necessary.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated curiosity, learning agility, willingness to explore, and enthusiasm for emerging technologies.

Preferred

  • Experience with Claude Code or other agentic AI development environments.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, Logic Apps, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience designing and deploying AI agents, multi-step agentic workflows, AI tools, and human-in-the-loop processes.
  • Experience with RAG, vector databases, semantic search, enterprise knowledge management, document intelligence, model evaluation, AI observability, and prompt or context engineering.
  • Experience evaluating multiple AI models or platforms according to solution quality, security, cost, latency, integration requirements, and enterprise suitability.
  • Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as ERP, CRM, HRIS, procurement, warehouse management, eCommerce, or supply chain systems.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, SDLC, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Experience supporting global business operations or working in electronics, technology, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or supply chain environments.

Professional Competencies

AI-Native Engineering: AI is a natural and significant part of how you work. You use tools such as Claude throughout the engineering lifecycle to research, explore, design, develop, test, debug, document, and improve solutions. You understand how to provide AI with appropriate context, assess the quality of its output, recognize its limitations, and apply human engineering judgment when necessary.

Curiosity & Exploration: You are motivated by unfamiliar problems, ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and regularly experiment with emerging technologies. You explore multiple approaches before settling on a solution and continuously expand your technical and business knowledge.

Rapid Experimentation: You favor working prototypes and evidence over lengthy theoretical analysis. You use AI to explore alternatives quickly, validate assumptions, learn from unsuccessful approaches, and progressively evolve promising concepts into production-quality solutions.

Communication: You can explain complex ideas simply, facilitate productive business discussions, collaborate across technical disciplines, and clearly communicate technology choices, trade-offs, limitations, risks, and expected outcomes.

Engineering Judgment: You understand that AI-generated output must be reviewed and validated. You can distinguish between a convincing demonstration and a secure, maintainable, production-ready enterprise solution.

Bias for Action: You are comfortable moving quickly from problem discovery to experimentation and from successful experiments to production. You learn through building, testing, measuring, and iterating.

Business Impact: You measure success through business outcomes and demonstrable delivery improvements, including faster prototyping, reduced engineering effort, shorter iteration cycles, better decisions, improved productivity, reduced friction, and transformed ways of working.

Collaboration: You work effectively across business and technology teams, openly share knowledge, contribute reusable capabilities, and help other employees and technology teams adopt effective AI-assisted working practices.


Why join us

Our approach to employee wellness is holistic, which is why alongside competitive salaries, and excellent health and dental benefits, corporate employees have access to the following:

  • Wellness amenities such as an onsite gym, fitness studio
  • Group RRSP plan to take care of the future you

  • Daily shuttle bus from two downtown locations
  • Subsidized employee cafe with delicious meals and snacks

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Supra ITS

Supra ITs builds an enterprise agent platform that customers run in the cloud or on-prem. Admins create and entitle custom agents (prompts, tools, knowledge). End users chat with those agents over documents, SQL, policy RAG, and operational systems (e.g. ticket triage, order audit, product intelligence).

The platform is a real product: FastAPI + LangGraph agents, React admin/chat UI, Postgres/Supabase, Qdrant, MCP tool servers, LiteLLM gateway, dual-cloud (AWS/GCP) and Docker/Kubernetes installs.

The role

You will own agent runtime and AI-adjacent backend: how skills are built, how tools are called, how retrieval and file context work, and how LLM traffic is routed, attributed, and kept safe. You will ship with Test Driven Development, architecture decision records, and story-level acceptance criteria — not notebooks that never reach production.

You Will Work Across

  • LangGraph / Deep Agent graphs (ReAct, multi-step research, custom skills)
  • Tooling: native file/SQL/todo tools, MCP (policy search, Graph files, customer systems)
  • RAG & retrieval: Qdrant collections per agent, hybrid/keyword fallback, knowledge ingest vs chat attachments
  • AI Gateway: LiteLLM, model aliases, spend attribution, fail-clear routing
  • Product surfaces: Agent Chat, Admin Builder, Sandbox, entitlements/deploy

Frontend (React/TypeScript) is not the primary hire, but you will touch chat/sandbox contracts when the agent loop or upload path changes.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement agent loops: system prompts, tool selection, state (messages, virtual FS, conversation persistence), streaming SSE
  • Add or harden tools (MCP and native) with clear failure modes — no silent drops, no leaking secrets in client errors
  • Improve retrieval quality (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, citations grounded in tool output)
  • Integrate the LiteLLM gateway: routing, timeouts, streaming, per-agent/skill attribution
  • Keep chat attachments, durable conversation artifacts, and knowledge corpus on the correct stores (they are not the same)
  • Write pytest (and Vitest when you change UI contracts); trace work to user stories and ADRs
  • Partner with Product, Architect, QA, and UX on sandbox-first proofs before entitle/deploy
  • Support on-prem and dual-cloud constraints: Postgres as source of truth, no “works only on one vendor’s blob store”

Must-have Qualifications

  • Strong Python in production services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Hands-on LLM application work: function/tool calling, RAG, prompt + eval loops — not only wrapping a chatbot widget
  • Comfort with LangChain / LangGraph (or equivalent graph/agent orchestration) and debugging multi-turn tool traces
  • Solid SQL / Postgres; you can reason about migrations, RLS, and “this belongs in a row vs object storage”
  • TDD habit: you write the failing test first for services that can lie to users (file extract, persist, authz)
  • Clear written design: you can explain trade-offs (e.g. hydrate files from DB vs S3) to non-research stakeholders
  • [3–5+ years] software engineering, including [1–2+] years shipping LLM features

Nice to have

  • Vector DBs (Qdrant), embeddings pipelines, hybrid/BM25 + dense retrieval
  • MCP servers or OpenAI-compatible tool catalogs
  • LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI / Anthropic, gateway or router experience
  • React/TypeScript (Vite) enough to wire FormData, SSE, and admin sandbox
  • Knowledge graphs / Neo4j (Product Intelligence / Deep Research)
  • Enterprise authz (JWT, RBAC, entitlements), OWASP-minded reviews
  • Docker/Kubernetes, AWS and/or GCP, on-prem install empathy
  • Domain exposure: manufacturing/distribution, ticketing (ConnectWise-class), policy/audit workflows

What This Role Is Not

  • Training or fine-tuning foundation models as the main job
  • Pure data science / notebook research with no production bar
  • Prompt-only “AI consultant” without owning the runtime

How We Work

Stories → ADRs → TDD implementation → review → QA. Caps and fail-closed behavior are product requirements (e.g. max files per turn, no silent truncate). You will be expected to prove behavior in Admin Sandbox the same way production Chat works.

title: Competitive Intelligence Director
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is looking for a Competitive Intelligence Director to define and operationalize a company-wide competitive intelligence function. This is an individual-contributor role with broad strategic scope: you will build the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that turn fragmented market and competitor information into useful decisions for Product Management, Product Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Solutions Engineering.

You will help Horizon3 understand a competitive landscape that includes competitors at different stages of maturity, establish clear priorities across product domains, and make intelligence actionable. Your work will influence product strategy and roadmap discussions, sharpen market and campaign strategy, and give account executives and solutions engineers timely, credible guidance during active sales cycles.

What You’ll Do

Set the competitive-intelligence strategy

  • Own the company-wide strategy for competitive intelligence, including the priorities, principles, operating model, and ways of working that make intelligence useful across Horizon3.

  • Define how Horizon3 identifies, evaluates, tiers, and tracks competitors across product domains and stages of maturity.

  • Establish clear standards for source quality, confidence, recency, context, and responsible use of intelligence.

  • Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing leaders to focus research on the product areas, buyer needs, and competitors that matter most.

Build a scalable operating system

  • Create the processes, taxonomies, repositories, intake mechanisms, and dissemination cadences needed to scale competitive intelligence beyond one-off research requests.

  • Use AI tools to improve the collection, organization, synthesis, and distribution of competitive information while applying sound human judgment and maintaining claim integrity.

  • Develop repeatable methods for converting raw information into concise takeaways, implications, recommended actions, and points of view for specific audiences.

  • Create feedback loops so field questions, competitive objections, deal outcomes, product developments, and market changes continuously improve the intelligence function.

Turn intelligence into product and market decisions

  • Translate competitive findings into insights that help guide product strategy and roadmap discussions without owning the product roadmap.

  • Work with Product Management and Product Marketing in defined product areas to clarify differentiation, identify gaps, test assumptions, and sharpen positioning.

  • Identify patterns across competitor capabilities, messaging, packaging, go-to-market motions, and customer perceptions.

  • Help develop discrete takeaway campaigns and strategies in partnership with Campaigns, Product Management, and Product Marketing.

  • Develop an executive and leadership-network intelligence capability using appropriate professional and publicly available information: map relevant leadership relationships and prior company affiliations, track business outcomes, understand leadership priorities such as IPOs, private-equity transactions, hypergrowth, or fundraising, and monitor how those priorities and outcomes evolve over time. Use this insight to inform account strategy, executive engagement, positioning, and competitive planning without collecting or inferring sensitive personal information.

Enable revenue teams in the field

  • Equip account executives and solutions engineers with timely, practical guidance for active sales cycles, including competitor context, objection handling, differentiation, discovery prompts, and recommended next steps.

  • Create and maintain competitive enablement materials such as battlecards, comparison guidance, talk tracks, briefing materials, and sales plays.

  • Stay close to field feedback, customer and prospect conversations, competitive objections, win/loss patterns, and deal dynamics so the function reflects what is happening in the market.

  • Help teams distinguish durable competitive insight from anecdote, outdated information, or unsupported claims.

Make intelligence visible and actionable

  • Design dissemination approaches that deliver the right level of detail to the right audience, from executive decisions and product planning to campaign development and deal support.

  • Build clear communication rhythms and points of access so competitive intelligence is discoverable, current, and easy to use.

  • Measure the usefulness and adoption of the function through feedback, engagement, asset usage, field impact, and the quality of decisions it supports.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience building, leading, or operating a competitive-intelligence, market-intelligence, strategy, product marketing, or closely related function in a complex B2B technology environment.

  • A track record of turning disparate market and competitor information into clear recommendations for product, marketing, and revenue stakeholders.

  • Experience designing scalable research and knowledge workflows, including prioritization, categorization, synthesis, and dissemination.

  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve research, analysis, knowledge management, or information distribution.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work credibly with Product Management, Product Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Solutions Engineering.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between executive-level synthesis, product detail, and field-ready guidance.

  • Sound judgment about evidence, uncertainty, confidentiality, and the difference between a useful insight and an unverified claim.

  • The ability to work independently, create structure in an ambiguous environment, and drive outcomes across teams without relying on formal authority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, identity, application security, exposure management, or a related technical market.

  • Experience supporting competitive selling, win/loss analysis, deal strategy, sales enablement, or field intelligence.

  • Experience partnering with product teams on market requirements, product strategy, roadmap inputs, or competitive differentiation.

  • Experience building a competitive-intelligence function from an early stage or scaling one across multiple product lines.

  • Familiarity with research automation, knowledge-management systems, or AI-assisted intelligence workflows.

What We’re Looking For

  • You take ownership of the diagnosis, the next action, and the follow-through rather than waiting for a perfectly defined request.

  • You can move from strategy to operating detail: defining the model, building the workflow, producing the first useful asset, and improving the system from real feedback.

  • You are rigorous without being slow. You know when to go deep, when to state uncertainty clearly, and when a timely, decision-ready answer is more valuable than an exhaustive report.

  • You are commercially minded and connect intelligence to product choices, market positioning, campaign performance, sales productivity, and customer outcomes.

  • You stay close to the work: the product, the customer, the competitive claim, the field question, and the active deal.

  • You communicate with precision and adapt your message for executives, product leaders, marketers, account executives, and technical evaluators.

  • You build trust through accuracy, context, responsiveness, and respect for different functional perspectives.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $209,000 - $274,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Bonus opportunity: Eligible for an annual performance bonus target of 20%.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Director of European Sellers
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Key responsibilities

Drive sellers engagement

  • Define and lead the engagement strategy for more than 1,000 European sellers, with a differentiated approach for strategic sellers, high-potential accounts and the wider seller portfolio.

  • Oversee the day-to-day support model for strategic and high-potential sellers, ensuring clear ownership, effective communication and fast resolution of key issues.

  • Drive seller participation in strategic programmes, including Trade-in, B2B and other Special Programs (New Battery, Outlet, Premium, etc.).

  • Define clear programme frameworks covering eligibility criteria, seller benefits, progression rules and performance expectations.

  • Strengthen sellers loyalty and increase the contribution of strategic and high-performing sellers to Back Market’s business.

Drive sellers performance and business results

  • Enable sustainable commercial growth : ensure GMV growth is delivered alongside strong quality, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

  • Strengthen seller competitiveness and unlock growth : Improve seller performance across pricing, stock availability, assortment, and customer experience, while identifying and closing seller, category, and assortment gaps that constrain growth across Europe.

  • Set clear performance standards and manage the operating cadence through dashboards, business reviews, action plans and regular performance routines.

  • Synthesize seller and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for the Executive Committee and General Managers, enabling faster and better-informed decisions on seller and marketplace topics.

Build and lead a high-performing team

  • Lead a high-performing EU Sellers organization: Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and commercial impact, while fostering a positive, ambitious, and collaborative team culture.

  • Develop and retain talent: Support each direct report through regular coaching, actionable feedback, effective delegation, and clear career development paths.

  • Strengthen performance and leadership: Leverage Back Market’s people processes to recognize contribution, address performance gaps, and develop future leaders.

  • Lead through change: Guide the team through organizational and operational changes, supporting the adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working.

Represent Back Market in the market

  • Build deep European market expertise: Develop a strong understanding of the refurbishment market, including seller economics, competitive dynamics, industry trends, and evolving customer expectations.

  • Build trusted industry relationships: Establish credibility and strong partnerships with sellers, brands, global suppliers, aggregators, and other key stakeholders across the ecosystem.

  • Represent Back Market externally: Act as a senior ambassador for Back Market across Europe and represent the company at key internal and external events, including Back Forum and relevant industry trade shows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Relevant industry experience: Experience in an international marketplace, refurbishment, trading, or a comparable global commercial environment.

  • Refurbishment market expertise: Deep understanding of refurbishers’ operational constraints and business realities across Hong Kong, mainland China, Europe, and the United States.

  • Strategic clarity: Ability to translate complex topics into clear insights and help senior leaders understand local market challenges and their business implications.

  • Commercial and stakeholder leadership: Proven ability to manage complex negotiations and business situations with sellers, internal stakeholders, and C-suite executives.

  • Practical problem-solving: A pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to addressing complex operational and commercial challenges.

  • Analytical strength: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data and insights to inform decisions and drive impact.

  • People leadership: Demonstrated leadership experience and a strong commitment to coaching teams and developing emerging leaders.

  • Relationship building: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse stakeholders and cultures.

  • Language skills: Fluency in English.

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Engineering (Remote)
description:
Contact: Feel free to connect with https://www.linkedin.com/in/gchambers/


Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering


About the Company

A well-funded health tech unicorn building the full operating system for independent medical practices across the US. The platform serves over 140,000 providers and covers the complete practice lifecycle — clinical infrastructure, billing, compliance, revenue cycle management, and patient acquisition. A significant portion of recent funding is mandated for a root-to-branch AI transformation across the entire product and business. The engineering culture is senior, stable, and high-retention — average tenure on the team is six to seven years.


The Role

The Revenue Cycle Management team is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the hands-on implementation, design, and adoption of AI agents and AI-native capabilities across their billing and revenue cycle platform.

This role combines deep software engineering expertise with direct experience building production AI systems. You will help transform how healthcare organizations manage billing, payments, claims, and operational workflows by applying Large Language Models, intelligent automation, retrieval systems, and agentic AI architectures to solve real-world business problems.

As a senior individual contributor, you will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, AI systems engineering, and business transformation. You will influence technical strategy across teams, implement reusable AI capabilities, and establish engineering standards for building reliable, secure, and scalable AI-powered systems.


An important note on language: Much of the hands-on AI agent implementation is expected to use Python and frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. Because the team's day-to-day platform work includes Java and Spring Boot, the successful candidate must also be comfortable contributing to Java codebases, reviewing Java code, and mentoring engineers who work primarily in Java. Mastery of both languages is not required - expert-level depth in either Python or Java, combined with working proficiency in the other, is the bar.


What You'll Work On

  • Own hands-on implementation of production AI agents and agentic workflows, with particular emphasis on Python-based stacks such as LangChain and LangGraph
  • Design, develop, test, and operate AI-enabled services that combine agent orchestration, application logic, APIs, retrieval, and AI models for real customer and operational use cases
  • Connect Python-based AI agents and services with Java/Spring Boot platform services through well-defined APIs, events, and contracts; contribute in both ecosystems as needed
  • Integrate LLMs, ML models, enterprise data sources, and external AI services using strong engineering patterns for reliability, observability, maintainability, and security
  • Build bounded, auditable AI workflows with clear fallback behavior, evaluation, authorization boundaries, and human review where appropriate
  • Partner with product, design, data, and operational teams to turn workflow pain points into scalable software solutions with measurable impact
  • Conduct thorough code reviews across AI services and Java/Spring Boot codebases; mentor junior and mid-level engineers including those whose primary work is in Java
  • Identify bottlenecks and improve latency, throughput, quality, and cost across AI agent workflows and backend service layers
  • Evaluate emerging AI engineering practices and adopt them when they improve product quality or delivery speed


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building scalable distributed systems
  • Expert-level depth in Python or Java, with working proficiency in the other; comfort reading, writing, and reviewing Java code and mentoring Java engineers is required regardless of primary language
  • 2-3+ years of hands-on experience designing, shipping, and maintaining production AI-enabled applications combining LLMs, core application logic, and business workflows
  • Practical experience with AI orchestration frameworks — LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI — and deep understanding of RAG, tool calling, context and state management, and HITL patterns
  • Strong background in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and messaging platforms such as Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience building multi-step agents that use tools, retrieval, state or memory, structured outputs, and explicit control flow — able to explain design decisions and production tradeoffs
  • Proven experience implementing production AI safeguards: real-time observability, latency and cost monitoring, automated evaluation pipelines, and robust fallback mechanisms
  • Cloud-native experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP


Preferred

  • Healthcare IT, RCM, billing, claims processing, fintech, or similarly regulated, high-compliance domain background
  • Experience building autonomous multi-step agentic systems with multi-tier memory and recursive reasoning
  • Knowledge graph construction and enterprise vector search architecture
  • PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, custom embedding models, or fine-tuning experience
  • Past experience as a Founding Engineer, Principal Architect, or early-stage platform lead driving org-wide AI/ML adoption

title: Senior .NET Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior .NET Engineer with Experience in Vulnerability Fixes

Location: Remote in Canada

Duration: Long-term contract

Rate: CAD60-CAD63/hr


Job Summary


We are seeking a Senior .NET Engineer with strong expertise in application security, vulnerability remediation, and secure software development. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience analyzing and remediating security vulnerabilities identified through DAST, SAST, and SCA tools across enterprise-scale .NET applications, APIs, and cloud-hosted platforms.

This role requires hands-on experience with security remediation initiatives, OWASP Top 10 vulnerability fixes, secure coding practices, DevSecOps, and AI-assisted development tools. The successful candidate will work directly with security, engineering, and client teams to identify, analyze, and remediate vulnerabilities while improving the overall security posture of mission-critical applications.


Key Responsibilities


  • Analyze, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities identified through DAST, SAST, and SCA security assessment tools.
  • Review and interpret security scan reports and perform root-cause analysis of application security findings.
  • Design, develop, and maintain secure .NET applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.
  • Implement fixes for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and other security-related findings across web applications and APIs.
  • Perform secure code reviews and ensure compliance with secure coding standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with security teams, architects, developers, and application owners to resolve security risks and compliance requirements.
  • Support and secure internet-facing applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations.
  • Integrate security testing and validation into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.
  • Validate remediation efforts through re-scans, penetration testing support, and security verification activities.
  • Document security findings, remediation approaches, root-cause analyses, and lessons learned.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to development teams on secure software engineering practices.
  • Partner directly with client stakeholders to communicate remediation status, security risks, and mitigation strategies.
  • Utilize AI-assisted development and security tools to accelerate vulnerability analysis, remediation, code reviews, and developer productivity.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in .NET software development using C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, and Web APIs.
  • Strong experience identifying and remediating application security vulnerabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more security testing tools:
  • AppScan
  • Checkmarx
  • SonarQube
  • Veracode
  • Fortify
  • Snyk
  • Black Duck
  • Similar DAST/SAST/SCA platforms
  • Proven track record of remediating:
  • SQL Injection
  • Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
  • Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
  • Authentication & Authorization Issues
  • Sensitive Data Exposure
  • Security Misconfigurations
  • API Security Vulnerabilities
  • OWASP Top 10 Findings
  • Experience supporting internet-facing enterprise applications and APIs.
  • Strong understanding of application security principles and secure coding practices.
  • Experience working with Azure, AWS, or other cloud-hosted environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar build platforms.
  • Experience with container security, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application security.
  • Knowledge of OAuth, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC, and Identity Management.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated environments such as Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Insurance.
  • Familiarity with threat modeling and security architecture principles.

title: Senior Solution Architect - Capital Management Applications #26-29122
description:
Duration: 1 year (Extension possible)
Schedule: Monday-Friday, core business hours; 4 days onsite (ideally)
Job Description:
  • The architect will design business-facing applications that allow users to manage reference data, apply controlled adjustments, create and compare scenarios, perform sandbox analysis, execute modelling and transformation workflows, and consume reporting and analytical outputs.
  • The target architecture will combine Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Python, APIs, modern web UI technologies and enterprise data platforms.
  • This is primarily a solution and application architecture role. The successful candidate must be able to architect the complete solution across the user experience, API/service layer, Python business logic, Databricks processing, data persistence, security and infrastructure.
  • This is not primarily a BI/reporting, data architecture, data-engineering or Azure infrastructure role.

Primary Purpose of the Role:
  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for interactive capital management and financial data applications.
  • Design applications supporting reference data, financial adjustments, scenario modelling, sandbox analysis, modelling workflows and reporting.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership throughout implementation, testing and deployment.

Responsibilities:
  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture from interactive web UI through APIs and backend services to Databricks and underlying data platforms.
  • Architect applications supporting:
    • Reference-data management.
    • Controlled financial and capital adjustments.
    • Scenario creation, versioning and comparison.
    • Sandbox and what-if analysis.
    • Modelling and calculation workflows.
    • Financial and management reporting.
  • Define clear separation between source data, reference data, user adjustments, scenario data, calculated results and published/approved outputs.
  • Design Python-based services, APIs and processing components, including contracts and integration patterns between UI, application services and Databricks.
  • Define approaches for scenario isolation, versioning, reproducibility, concurrency, persistence and comparison.
  • Design controlled adjustment workflows supporting audit history, traceability, authorization, approval/rejection and rollback/reversal as required.
  • Determine which processing should occur in the interactive application/service tier versus Databricks, balancing latency, scalability, maintainability and cost.
  • Define appropriate Azure and Databricks architecture, including compute, storage, integration, networking, security and deployment patterns.
  • Design solutions incorporating enterprise identity and access controls such as Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities/service principals and secrets management.
  • Establish patterns for observability, exception handling, resiliency, auditability and operational support.
  • Evaluate architectural options and document technology choices, trade-offs and architecture decisions.
  • Translate capital-management and financial requirements into implementable technical designs.
  • Produce architecture deliverables including solution/component diagrams, sequence diagrams, API contracts, data flows, deployment architecture and architecture decision records.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership to developers and engineering teams throughout implementation, testing and deployment.

Experience:
  • 10+ years of overall experience.
  • Significant experience as a Solution Architect or Application Architect delivering enterprise-scale, business-facing applications.
  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture from UI through API/backend services to data and processing platforms.

Skillsets:
MUST-HAVE:
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python for enterprise application services, business logic or analytical applications.
  • Strong API architecture experience, preferably including REST APIs, authentication/authorization, API versioning, error handling and API lifecycle management.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including integrating Databricks processing into interactive enterprise applications.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure architecture experience with relevant services such as:
    • Azure SQL
    • ADLS
    • Azure Functions
    • App Service
    • AKS
    • Key Vault
    • API Management
  • Experience designing applications that support data adjustments, reference-data workflows, scenarios, simulations, forecasting or comparable stateful analytical workflows.
  • Experience designing for versioning, auditability, traceability and reproducibility of user-generated analytical data.
  • Strong understanding of application security, Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, service identities, networking and secrets management.
  • Strong understanding of distributed application patterns, APIs, integration, asynchronous processing and scalable backend design.
  • Ability to evaluate alternatives and explain specific engineering trade-offs, including latency, scalability, maintainability, security, complexity and cost.
  • Ability to operate at both architecture and implementation level, including reviewing designs, APIs, schemas and code.

NICE-TO-HAVE:
  • Experience within banking, capital management, finance, treasury, risk or regulatory reporting.
  • Experience with capital calculations, forecasting, stress testing, simulation or scenario-management platforms.
  • Experience with modern web application technologies such as React, Angular or equivalent, particularly applications backed by Python/API services.
  • Experience with Delta Lake / Databricks SQL and governed analytical data platforms.
  • Experience designing maker/checker or approval-controlled financial adjustments.
  • Experience implementing audit trails, lineage and controls for regulated financial applications.
  • Experience designing sandbox environments that allow controlled experimentation without compromising production or authoritative datasets.

Education:

  • Work Arrangement: Ideally 4 days onsite.

title: Experienced Analytics Engineer - Customer Experience

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. Are you ready to join us?

Join our Customer Experience Analytics team and help build the data foundation behind a better customer journey at Back Market. We collect trustworthy behavioural data, build analyses, and help teams use data in their day-to-day decisions.

This role combines hands-on data modelling with a strong understanding of business needs. You will help define the metrics, datasets and tools that allow the Customer Experience teams to move quickly while keeping a high level of trust in the data.

Your mission

You will own and develop the analytics engineering foundations for the Customer Experience vertical.

Build trusted data foundations

  • Build, maintain and improve production-grade data models using dbt and BigQuery.

  • Partner with product, business, operations and engineering teams to assess new product and service opportunities.

  • Help teams define the right metrics, data requirements and success criteria before a project starts.

  • Build the datasets and reporting needed to monitor adoption, customer behaviour, operational performance and business impact after launch.

  • Use data to identify opportunities to improve existing products and services.

Enable experimentation and customer engagement analytics

  • Build reliable datasets for product and business experiments, including experiment populations, exposure data, treatment groups and results.

  • Partner with analysts and product teams to improve behavioural tracking and experiment analysis.

  • Build and maintain data models for CRM and Braze performance.

  • Support customer segmentation, lifecycle analysis and campaign measurement.

  • Help teams understand how product and CRM initiatives affect engagement, conversion, retention and customer experience.

Make analytics accessible and reliable

  • Build trusted datasets and reusable components in OMNI.

  • Define clear metrics and dimensions that stakeholders can use independently.

  • Implement tests, monitoring and alerts for critical data models.

  • Document model logic, metric definitions, ownership and known limitations.

  • Support analysts and business stakeholders in using the right data for their decisions.

  • Contribute to analytics engineering standards, data governance and best practices across the team.

You should apply if

You have:

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analysis engineering, business intelligence engineering or a similar role.

  • Strong expertise with dbt, BigQuery, Python, and SQL—you're comfortable building production-grade data models

  • Track record of translating business needs into reliable data infrastructure

  • Excellent communication skills in English; French is a plus but not required

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing and scaling data pipelines with orchestration tools like Airflow

  • Experience working with event-based or behavioural data.

  • Experience working with external data sources or data enrichment

Familiarity with data quality frameworks and testing

  • Individual contributor role

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

title: Team Lead, Data Migration Services
description:
Retire the ERP

At Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.

In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.

You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.

The Role

  • Own the data migration practice end to end: every customer moving to Light from Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage or spreadsheets goes through you and your team.

  • Lead, coach and grow a small team of migration specialists, setting priorities across a pipeline of concurrent customer migrations and keeping go-live dates on track.

  • Run migrations hands-on when it matters: extracting legacy data, mapping charts of accounts, business partners, open invoices and balances, and reconciling the result back to the source system.

  • Build and maintain the source-system connectors and migration flows that power our Zero Day Implementation offering, so a new customer’s records can be converted into Light in hours, not weeks.

  • Use AI and automation to speed up mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, and turn repeated manual work into productised, self-serve tooling with Engineering and Product.

  • Set the standards: migration methodology, mapping templates, reconciliation checks, data quality rules, and clear scope boundaries (what we migrate, what we don’t, and what’s billable, such as historical documents and attachments).

  • Be the expert voice with customers’ finance leaders on migration questions, including multi-entity, consolidation, FX and VAT treatment, and be clear with them when a request would put accuracy or timelines at risk.

  • Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with migration scoping, effort estimates and sample migrations for prospects.

  • Track and report on migration throughput, time to go-live and data accuracy, and use them to decide where to automate next.

How You Fit Into The Team

As Team Lead, Data Migration Services, you sit at the front door of every Light customer relationship. Implementation Managers own the customer journey; you own getting their history into Light accurately and fast. You’ll partner daily with Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering and Sales, and report directly to the Head of Services.

This is a player-coach role: you’ll lead a small team and still roll up your sleeves on the hardest migrations and connector builds. Your biggest mandate is making “zero day conversion” real: run the records first, then run the processes.

Your Qualifications Could Be

  • You have personally delivered at least one full accounting system migration through go-live and sign-off (for example Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or NetSuite into a new platform). This is a must.

  • Around 5 years in ERP data migration, finance systems implementation or accounting technology, including some time leading people or a workstream.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of Xero, QuickBooks Online, NetSuite or Sage as a source system.

  • Strong accounting fundamentals: you understand double entry, trial balances, AR/AP subledgers, multi-entity, multi-currency and UK VAT, and can reconcile to the penny.

  • Technical depth to build, not just configure: comfortable with REST APIs, OAuth, SQL, and scripting (Python or TypeScript) for extraction and transformation.

  • Practical, evidenced experience using AI tools to speed up data mapping, cleansing or migration work.

  • Experience designing repeatable ETL processes, mapping templates and data validation checks.

  • A clear, confident communicator with finance leaders, who can explain when a request isn’t sound and suggest a better way.

  • Able to manage many concurrent migrations while keeping quality high, with the support of a team you’ll shape.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • A background as an accountant, auditor or finance systems consultant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar).

  • Experience building or maintaining integrations with accounting platform APIs (Xero, QBO, NetSuite SuiteTalk/SuiteQL).

  • Exposure to IFRS, UK GAAP, consolidations, intercompany and revenue recognition.

  • Experience at a SaaS or fintech company turning services work into product.

  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools like n8n.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary plus equity.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Final Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

If you love clean data, hate month-long implementations, and want to build the team that makes switching to Light effortless, we’d love to hear from you at Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀

title: Deep Tech Networking Engineer, DPDK / Linux - Paris - H/F
description:
At Free/Iliad, we build embedded networking products including 5G and edge gateways, OLTs, carrier-grade routers and NPU-based appliances.

Our systems forward tens to hundreds of Gbps on Arm64 SoCs, x86, ASICs and DPUs, within strict power and hardware constraints. The dataplane runs on DPDK or dedicated hardware, while Linux remains the control plane.

Performance is not theoretical. We measure Mpps, p99 latency, jitter and watts per Gbps on real hardware deployed at scale.

Open source is also central to how we work. Rather than maintaining private patches through every rebase, we contribute improvements to DPDK, Linux, U-Boot and Buildroot. Depending on the project and your experience, upstream work may represent between 20% and 80% of your time. It is planned and tracked like any other deliverable.

We are looking for engineers who want to make packets go faster, understand why they go faster and prove it with numbers.



Description du poste

Your role :

You will design, develop and optimise high-performance networking systems from the hardware to the dataplane.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building packet-processing pipelines with DPDK, including PMDs, mempools, mbufs, rings, lcores, eventdev, graph libraries and QoS.
  • Connecting the Linux control plane to the dataplane by synchronising routes, neighbours and interfaces through netlink.
  • Maintaining exception paths to the kernel using technologies such as virtio-user, TAP and shared-memory rings.
  • Developing Linux networking on embedded targets, including netdev and PHY drivers, phylink, DSA, switchdev, TC flower, XDP and AF_XDP.
  • Working close to the hardware with VFIO, IOMMU, hugepages, CPU isolation, device trees, U-Boot and Buildroot.
  • Profiling and measuring performance with perf, ftrace, bpftrace, PMU counters, TRex, pktgen and testpmd.
  • Investigating complex production issues such as intermittent packet drops, descriptor exhaustion, cache contention and IOMMU faults.
  • Working directly with SoC and NIC vendors on drivers, firmware interfaces and upstreamable solutions.
  • Submitting and reviewing patches, responding to maintainers and following changes until they are merged.
  • Writing design documents, reviewing code and helping other engineers grow.

Your scope will depend on your experience. You may start by owning a feature, a PMD or a board family, or take responsibility for the architecture of an entire dataplane subsystem across several products.

During your first year, you will bring up our stack on target hardware, reproduce existing performance baselines and deliver a measurable improvement on a production platform.



Qualifications

Your profile :

We are open to both experienced open-source contributors and engineers with excellent foundations who want to develop deep expertise in Linux networking and packet processing.

You have:

  • Strong C programming skills and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Good knowledge of L2 and L3 networking, including Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4/IPv6, ARP/ND, routing, FIB lookups, VXLAN, GRE and IPsec.
  • Experience with DPDK or another high-performance packet-processing stack such as VPP, ODP, AF_XDP or OVS-DPDK.
  • An understanding of performance topics such as caches, NUMA, DMA, PCIe and SR-IOV.
  • Experience or strong interest in Linux kernel networking, embedded systems, drivers, cross-compilation or board bring-up.
  • A disciplined approach to optimisation: measure, change, compare and document.
  • Clear written English for technical documentation, code reviews and upstream discussions.

You do not need to have mastered every technology listed in this announcement. We will pay particular attention to what you have built, how deeply you understand it and how you demonstrate its technical impact.

Public open-source contributions are valuable. If your strongest work is closed-source, be ready to explain the technical decisions you made, the constraints you faced and the results you achieved.

For Staff and Senior Staff positions, we expect a proven public track record through patches, reviews, maintainer responsibilities or contributions to projects such as DPDK, Linux, U-Boot, Buildroot, Zephyr, Yocto, FRR or VPP.

Experience with SmartNICs or DPUs such as NVIDIA BlueField, Marvell OCTEON, NXP DPAA2 or Intel IPU is a plus, as is experience with switchdev, SAI, SONiC, PTP, TSN, KernelCI, LAVA or DPDK DTS.

What matters most is what you have shipped, what you can demonstrate and the technical impact you want to create.



Informations supplémentaires

Recruitment process

  • 15-minute phone screen with Steve, the recruiter
  • 30-minute interview with Vincent, the hiring manager
  • 60-minute technical interview
  • 60-minute HR interview with Sarah and Steve

Benefits :

  • Profit-sharing and incentive scheme based on the Group’s performance
  • Reimbursement of your Free home internet plan
  • One to two remote-working days per week
  • Secure bicycle parking
  • On-site restaurants and cafeteria
  • Numerous internal mobility opportunities across the Iliad Group
  • Regular training opportunities and access to Free University to develop your skills
  • Unique workspaces located in an iconic building that is part of Paris’s architectural heritage
  • Public transport costs reimbursed up to 70%

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Job Description: Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer – French & English Bilingual


Language Requirement: Fluent in French and English (Mandatory)


Overview

We are seeking a motivated Generative AI Engineer with 1–3 years of experience in Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate should have strong programming skills in Python, a solid understanding of ML/AI fundamentals, and hands-on experience building GenAI applications using LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agent frameworks.

The candidate will work closely with senior engineers, data scientists, and cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deploy scalable GenAI solutions for real-world business problems. This role offers an opportunity to work on emerging technologies, including Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LangGraph, and open-source LLMs.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Generative AI applications using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines using document processing, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
  • Implement AI agents and workflow orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
  • Work with LLM APIs, including OpenAI APIs and cloud-based AI services.
  • Explore and integrate open-source models such as Llama, Mistral, and other Hugging Face models.
  • Perform prompt engineering and optimize prompts to improve response quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Assist in fine-tuning, evaluating, and optimizing LLMs for specific business use cases.
  • Develop Python scripts and APIs to integrate GenAI solutions with existing applications and enterprise systems.
  • Implement basic evaluation frameworks to assess LLM responses, RAG retrieval quality, relevance, and hallucination.
  • Optimize application performance by reducing response latency, token consumption, and computational costs.
  • Deploy and support GenAI applications on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
  • Follow software development best practices, including version control, testing, debugging, and code documentation.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into AI-powered solutions.
  • Stay updated with advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, and emerging AI frameworks.

Requirements

  • B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, AI, Data Science, or Generative AI development.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and neural network architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI applications, and prompt engineering.
  • Practical knowledge of RAG architecture, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience integrating LLMs through OpenAI APIs or other commercial/open-source model APIs.
  • Familiarity with vector databases or search technologies such as FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, or Azure AI Search.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, FastAPI or Flask, and application integration.
  • Familiarity with Git, Docker, and software development practices is preferred.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS is an advantage.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, willingness to learn, and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Agentic AI workflows, tool calling, and multi-agent systems.
  • Basic hands-on experience with LangGraph for stateful AI workflows.
  • Familiarity with open-source LLMs such as Llama, Mistral, and similar models.
  • Understanding of LLM evaluation, guardrails, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI practices.
  • Exposure to model fine-tuning, quantization, or inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with MLflow or other tools for experiment tracking and model management.

Key Skills

Core: Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, NLP

GenAI: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Embeddings, Vector Databases, LLM Evaluation

Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs

Deployment: FastAPI, REST APIs, Git, Docker, Azure/AWS

What We Are Looking For

A proactive and curious engineer who enjoys solving real-world problems using Generative AI, can build practical AI applications, and is eager to grow their expertise in Agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and scalable enterprise AI solutions.
